+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Shared fixtures of the Muse Spark specialized decode tests: a supported
+``VllmConfig`` stand-in and the MI355X platform for CPU runs."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode
+
+LAYERS = 62
+
+
+def muse_text_config(**over) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    """Muse Spark Open's text config (checkpoint c7bc74fd): 62 layers, every MLP
+    sparse, full attention (NoPE) on every fourth layer from layer 1."""
+    kinds = [
+        "full_attention" if i % 4 == 1 else "sliding_attention" for i in range(LAYERS)
+    ]
+    text = SimpleNamespace(
+        hidden_size=8192,
+        num_attention_heads=128,
+        num_key_value_heads=16,
+        head_dim=64,
+        num_local_experts=256,
+        num_experts_per_tok=8,
+        moe_hidden_size=4096,
+        moe_intermediate_size=4096,
+        num_shared_experts=0,
+        sliding_window=2048,
+        num_hidden_layers=LAYERS,
+        layer_types=kinds,
+        mlp_layer_types=["sparse"] * LAYERS,
+        layer_rope_theta=[0 if k == "full_attention" else 500000.0 for k in kinds],
+        gated_delta_net=None,
+    )
+    for k, v in over.items():
+        setattr(text, k, v)
+    return text
+
+
+def dspark(**over) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    """A supported speculative config: DSpark, 7 static speculative tokens."""
+    spec = SimpleNamespace(
+        method="dspark",
+        num_speculative_tokens=7,
+        enable_adaptive_verification=False,
+        dynamic=False,
+    )
+    spec.uses_dynamic_speculative_decoding = lambda: spec.dynamic
+    for k, v in over.items():
+        setattr(spec, k, v)
+    return spec
+
+
+def quark_config():
+    """A ``QuarkConfig`` instance (``isinstance`` is all stage 1 asks)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.quark.quark import QuarkConfig
+
+    return QuarkConfig.__new__(QuarkConfig)
+
+
+def vllm_config(**over) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    """A supported config: TP8, MRV2, plain decode, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs,
+    ROCM_AITER_FA, bf16 KV in blocks of 16, the Quark checkpoint, the switch on
+    through ``decode_backend``. ``over`` sets dotted paths, e.g.
+    ``{"parallel_config.data_parallel_size": 2}``."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+    c = SimpleNamespace(
+        additional_config={"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"},
+        kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(monokernel=False),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            tensor_parallel_size=8,
+            pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+            data_parallel_size=1,
+            enable_expert_parallel=False,
+            enable_eplb=False,
+            decode_context_parallel_size=1,
+            prefill_context_parallel_size=1,
+            use_ubatching=False,
+            use_sequence_parallel_moe=False,
+            enable_batch_sharded_sampling=None,
+        ),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            enable_sleep_mode=False,
+            enable_prompt_embeds=False,
+            hf_text_config=muse_text_config(),
+        ),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(cache_dtype="auto", block_size=16),
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_seqs=128),
+        attention_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            backend=AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_FA, backend_per_kind={}
+        ),
+        quant_config=quark_config(),
+        lora_config=None,
+        kv_transfer_config=None,
+        weight_transfer_config=None,
+        aux_output_config=SimpleNamespace(enable_return_routed_experts=False),
+        offload_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            uva=SimpleNamespace(cpu_offload_gb=0),
+            prefetch=SimpleNamespace(offload_group_size=0),
+        ),
+        speculative_config=None,
+        use_v2_model_runner=True,
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+            cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,
+            cudagraph_capture_sizes=[1, 2, 4, 8, 16],
+            max_cudagraph_capture_size=16,
+        ),
+    )
+    for path, v in over.items():
+        obj = c
+        *head, last = path.split(".")
+        for h in head:
+            obj = getattr(obj, h)
+        setattr(obj, last, v)
+    return c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def on_mi355x(monkeypatch):
+    """The platform stage 1 requires (gfx950, 256 CUs, FlyDSL), on any host;
+    MRV2's default env (pad masks maintained, fp32 reduce)."""

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The references and helpers the Muse Spark numerics tests share: the
+comparison metrics (cos, relative L2, bf16 ulps, the GEMV / ulp checks), the
+rank-order sums of K2's all-reduce and owner reduce, the K1 boundary's
+tolerance, the RoPE table, fp64 GQA decode through a block table, the stock
+attention core as decode runs it (``stock_attention``), KV cache fixtures and
+page assignment, and ``FakeMrv2`` (MRV2's persistent block tables, slot
+mappings, sequence lengths, positions and pad flags, written in place a step).
+Every function takes plain tensors (CPU or GPU) and reads its sizes from
+them.
+"""
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Collection, Mapping, Sequence
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import spec
+
+BF16 = torch.bfloat16
+F32 = torch.float32
+F64 = torch.float64
+
+
+def bf16_ulps(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """bf16 ulps between a and b (bf16 or rounded to it; +0 and -0 coincide)."""
+
+    def ordered(x):
+        i = x.to(BF16).contiguous().view(torch.int16).int()
+        return torch.where(i < 0, -(i & 0x7FFF), i)
+
+    return (ordered(a) - ordered(b)).abs()
+
+
+def cos(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.double().reshape(-1), b.double().reshape(-1)
+    return torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(a, b, dim=0).item()
+
+
+def rel_l2(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.double(), b.double()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm().clamp_min(1e-300)).item()
+
+
+def check_ulps(got, ref, *, frac: float = 0.999, max_ulps: int = 2, what="") -> None:
+    """<= 1 bf16 ulp on >= ``frac`` of the elements, never more than
+    ``max_ulps``."""
+    u = bf16_ulps(got, ref)
+    assert u.max().item() <= max_ulps, (what, u.max().item())
+    assert (u <= 1).float().mean().item() >= frac, (what, (u > 1).sum().item())
+
+
+def check_gemv(got, ref, x, w, *, frac: float = 0.999, what="") -> None:
+    """bf16 GEMV rows ``got`` vs ``ref`` of ``x @ w.T``: <= 1 bf16 ulp on >=
+    ``frac``, and past 1 ulp only within fp32 accumulation noise
+    (``|got - ref| <= 2^-20 sum_k |x w|``): two fp32 dots summed in different
+    orders can land 2 ulps apart on a cancelling sum, while a dropped K block
+    still fails."""
+    got, ref = got.cpu(), ref.cpu()
+    u = bf16_ulps(got, ref)
+    absdot = (x.double().abs() @ w.double().abs().T).cpu()
+    noise = (got.double() - ref.double()).abs() <= 2**-20 * absdot
+    assert ((u <= 1) | noise).all(), (what, u.max().item())
+    assert (u <= 1).float().mean().item() >= frac, (what, (u > 1).sum().item())
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the stages
+
+
+def _pad_mask(pad, rows: int, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The pad flags as bool [rows] (none when ``pad`` is None)."""
+    if pad is None:
+        return torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    return pad[:rows].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
+
+
+def rank_order_sum(parts: Sequence[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """fp32 sum of ``parts`` in rank (list) order."""
+    acc = parts[0].float()
+    for p in parts[1:]:
+        acc = acc + p.float()
+    return acc
+
+
+def attn_out(partials: Sequence[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The seam's all-reduce: the bf16 partials summed in fp32 in rank order,
+    rounded once (the custom-AR rule)."""
+    return rank_order_sum(partials).to(BF16)
+
+
+def _rsq(x: torch.Tensor, eps: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """fp32 ``rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)`` over the last dim."""
+    x = x.float()
+    return torch.rsqrt((x * x).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / x.shape[-1] + eps)
+
+
+def owner_sum(rows_by_rank: Sequence[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """R: the ranks' bf16 rows summed in fp32 in rank order, never rounded
+    (README, Numerics: the deviation)."""
+    return rank_order_sum(rows_by_rank)
+
+
+def owner_sumsq(R, w_postexp) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A pick's sum of ``(R (w + 1))^2`` over the pooled width, fp32 [S, 8]
+    (fp64 accumulation: the owners' fixed order is within fp32 rounding)."""
+    x = R.double() * (w_postexp.double() + spec.GAIN)
+    return x.square().sum(-1).float()
+
+
+def stream_tolerance(branch, stream, w_postffn, alpha, beta) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The ``stream_out`` bound (DESIGN_BC 4): ``1e-5 (|alpha s| + |beta y|)``,
+    elementwise; a relative bound fails where ``alpha s + beta y`` cancels."""
+    x = branch.float() * (w_postffn.float() + spec.GAIN)
+    y = x * _rsq(x, spec.POST_FFN_EPS)
+    return 1e-5 * ((alpha.float() * stream.float()).abs() + (beta.float() * y).abs())
+
+
+def rope_table(max_pos: int, theta: float = spec.ROPE_THETA, device="cpu"):
+    """A ``cos_sin_cache`` as ``RotaryEmbedding(64, 64, ..., dtype=float)``
+    builds it: fp32 [max_pos, 64], cos in columns 0 .. 31, sin in 32 .. 63."""
+    inv = 1.0 / (theta ** (torch.arange(0, 64, 2, dtype=F32) / 64))
+    freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(max_pos, dtype=F32), inv)
+    return torch.cat([freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()], -1).to(device)
+
+
+def gqa_decode(
+    q, kv, block_table, seq_lens, *, window: bool, scale=spec.QK_SCALE, pad=None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """fp64 decode attention of each row's q heads (bf16 [S, HEADS * 64] or
+    [S, HEADS, 64], as K1 leaves them) over its keys ``lo <= k < L`` through
+    the block table: ``L = clamp(seq_lens[t], 0, 16 * table row)``, ``lo = L -
+    WINDOW`` for a sliding layer (else 0), key k on page ``block_table[t, k //
+    16]`` row ``k % 16``; q head h reads KV head ``h // 8``. ``kv`` is a
+    layer's cache [blocks, KV_HEADS, KV_BLOCK, KV_C], any strides. Pad rows
+    and ``L == 0``: zeros. fp64 [S, HEADS, 64] (exact softmax)."""
+    S = q.shape[0]
+    pad = _pad_mask(pad, S, "cpu")
+    out = torch.zeros(S, spec.HEADS, spec.HEAD_DIM, dtype=F64)
+    cap = block_table.shape[1] * spec.KV_BLOCK
+    for t in range(S):
+        L = min(max(int(seq_lens[t]), 0), cap)
+        if bool(pad[t]) or L == 0:
+            continue
+        lo = max(0, L - spec.WINDOW) if window else 0
+        k = torch.arange(lo, L)
+        blocks = block_table[t].cpu().long()[k // spec.KV_BLOCK]
+        rows = kv[blocks.to(kv.device), :, (k % spec.KV_BLOCK).to(kv.device)]
+        rows = rows.cpu().double()  # [keys, KV_HEADS, KV_C]
+        K, V = rows[..., : spec.V_OFF], rows[..., spec.V_OFF :]
+        qh = q[t].cpu().double().reshape(spec.KV_HEADS, spec.Q_PER_KV, -1)
+        p = torch.softmax(torch.einsum("gjd,ngd->gjn", qh, K) * scale, -1)
+        out[t] = torch.einsum("gjn,ngd->gjd", p, V).reshape(spec.HEADS, -1)
+    return out
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- KV fixtures
+
+PAD_SLOT = -1  # MRV2's PAD_SLOT_ID: no insert
+
+
+def kv_cache(
+    num_blocks: int,
+    *,
+    layout: str = "LBHNC",
+    null: float = math.nan,
+    device="cpu",
+    generator: torch.Generator | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A layer's bf16 cache [num_blocks, KV_HEADS, KV_BLOCK, KV_C] as AITER FA
+    may lay it out: "LBHNC" (a block's heads adjacent, contiguous) or "LHBNC"
+    (head-major storage: ``stride(1) > stride(0)``). Random normal values;
+    block 0, the null block, holds ``null`` (NaN: a read of it shows)."""
+    dims = (num_blocks, spec.KV_HEADS, spec.KV_BLOCK, spec.KV_C)
+    if layout == "LBHNC":
+        kv = torch.randn(*dims, generator=generator)
+    elif layout == "LHBNC":
+        kv = torch.randn(dims[1], dims[0], *dims[2:], generator=generator)
+        kv = kv.transpose(0, 1)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"KV layout {layout!r} (LBHNC or LHBNC)")
+    kv = kv.to(device=device, dtype=BF16)
+    kv[0] = null
+    return kv
+
+
+def assign_pages(
+    seq_lens: Sequence[int],
+    num_blocks: int,
+    *,
+    extra: int = 0,
+    generator: torch.Generator | None = None,
+) -> list[list[int]]:
+    """Distinct random physical blocks (never 0, the null block) for each
+    request's ``cdiv(L, 16) + extra`` pages, in page order."""
+    need = [-(-L // spec.KV_BLOCK) + extra for L in seq_lens]
+    perm = torch.randperm(num_blocks - 1, generator=generator) + 1
+    if sum(need) > perm.numel():
+        raise ValueError(f"{sum(need)} pages > {num_blocks - 1} blocks")
+    out, at = [], 0
+    for n in need:
+        out.append(perm[at : at + n].tolist())
+        at += n
+    return out
+
+
+class FakeMrv2:
+    """Model Runner V2's persistent per-step inputs of the kernel layers
+    (DESIGN_BC 1.5), written in place a step as MRV2 writes them, so a captured
+    graph's addresses stay valid: per KV group a block table int32 [max_reqs,
+    max_blocks] (``BlockTables.input_block_tables[g]``) and a slot-mapping row
+    (``slot_mappings`` int64 [G, max_tokens]); ``seq_lens`` int32 [max_reqs];
+    ``positions`` int64 and ``is_padding`` bool [max_tokens].
+
+    ``groups``: KV group -> its layers' names; ``sliding``: the sliding
+    groups. A sliding group's entries wholly below the window of the
+    request's first scheduled token are nulled (block 0); entries past a
+    request's last page keep what an earlier step left (``stale`` fills them
+    instead); padded rows are zeroed."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        groups: Mapping[str, Sequence[str]],
+        sliding: Collection[str],
+        *,
+        max_reqs: int = spec.MAX_ROWS,
+        max_blocks: int = 256,
+        max_tokens: int = spec.MAX_ROWS,
+        device="cpu",
+    ):
+        self.groups = {g: tuple(names) for g, names in groups.items()}
+        self.sliding = frozenset(sliding)
+        self.block_tables = {
+            g: torch.zeros(max_reqs, max_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+            for g in self.groups
+        }
+        self.slot_mappings = torch.full(
+            (len(self.groups), max_tokens), PAD_SLOT, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+        self.seq_lens = torch.zeros(max_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.positions = torch.zeros(max_tokens, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.is_padding = torch.ones(max_tokens, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+
+    def _view(self, width: int, q: int) -> SimpleNamespace:
+        reqs = width // q
+        md, sm = {}, {}
+        for gi, (g, names) in enumerate(self.groups.items()):
+            for name in names:
+                sm[name] = self.slot_mappings[gi, :width]
+                md[name] = SimpleNamespace(
+                    block_table=self.block_tables[g][:reqs],
+                    seq_lens=self.seq_lens[:reqs],
+                    slot_mapping=sm[name],
+                    decode_metadata=SimpleNamespace(max_query_len=q),
+                    num_prefills=0,
+                    num_extends=0,
+                    num_decode_tokens=width,
+                    num_decodes=reqs,
+                )
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            width=width,
+            attn_metadata=md,
+            slot_mapping=sm,
+            positions=self.positions[:width],
+            pad=self.is_padding[:width],
+        )
+
+    def capture(self, width: int, q: int = 1) -> SimpleNamespace:
+        """A capture / dummy run: rows zeroed, ``seq_lens`` q (each dummy
+        request's query), slots ``PAD_SLOT``, positions 0, every row padding."""
+        reqs = width // q
+        for bt in self.block_tables.values():
+            bt[:reqs].zero_()
+        self.slot_mappings.fill_(PAD_SLOT)
+        self.seq_lens.zero_()
+        self.seq_lens[:reqs] = q
+        self.positions[:width].zero_()
+        self.is_padding[:width].fill_(True)
+        return self._view(width, q)
+
+    def step(
+        self,
+        seq_lens: Sequence[int],
+        pages: Mapping[str, Sequence[Sequence[int]]],
+        width: int,
+        q: int = 1,
+        *,
+        stale: int | None = None,
+    ) -> SimpleNamespace:
+        """One decode (q = 1) or uniform verify step of ``len(seq_lens)``
+        requests padded to ``width`` rows. ``seq_lens[r]``: request r's context
+        including this step's q tokens; ``pages[g][r]``: its physical blocks in
+        group g, page order. Returns the step's view: ``attn_metadata`` and
+        ``slot_mapping`` by layer name (slices of the persistent buffers),
+        ``positions``, ``pad``."""
+        reqs, padded = len(seq_lens), width // q
+        if padded * q != width or reqs > padded:
+            raise ValueError(f"{reqs} requests of {q} rows in a width {width}")
+        for gi, (g, bt) in enumerate(self.block_tables.items()):
+            self.slot_mappings[gi].fill_(PAD_SLOT)
+            for r in range(padded):
+                if r >= reqs:
+                    bt[r].zero_()
+                    continue
+                L = seq_lens[r]
+                n = -(-L // spec.KV_BLOCK)
+                ids = list(pages[g][r][:n])
+                if g in self.sliding:  # block_table.py: num_computed_tokens - reach
+                    null = max(L - q - (spec.WINDOW - 1), 0) // spec.KV_BLOCK
+                    ids[:null] = [0] * null
+                bt[r, :n] = torch.tensor(ids, dtype=torch.int32)
+                if stale is not None:
+                    bt[r, n:] = stale
+                for i in range(q):
+                    pos = L - q + i
+                    blk = pages[g][r][pos // spec.KV_BLOCK]
+                    self.slot_mappings[gi, r * q + i] = (
+                        blk * spec.KV_BLOCK + pos % spec.KV_BLOCK
+                    )
+        self.seq_lens.zero_()
+        self.seq_lens[:reqs] = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+        self.positions[:width].zero_()
+        self.is_padding[:width].fill_(True)
+        for r, L in enumerate(seq_lens):
+            self.positions[r * q : (r + 1) * q] = torch.arange(L - q, L)
+            self.is_padding[r * q : (r + 1) * q] = False
+        return self._view(width, q)
+
+
+def stock_attention(ns) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """What stock decode computes for ``ns`` (``case``: S, window, lens;
+    ``kv``, ``bt``, ``seq_lens``, ``qkvo``): ``paged_attention_v1`` on the
+    layer's cache views (``_split_kv_cache``), a sliding layer on
+    ``_build_swa_decode_tables``' window-trimmed table with the window 2048,
+    a full layer on the whole table. bf16 [S, 16, 64]."""
+    import aiter  # noqa: F401
+
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import (
+        _PARTITION_SIZE_ROCM,
+        AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    )
+
+    case, dev = ns.case, ns.kv.device
+    S = case.S
+    key_cache, value_cache = ns.kv.transpose(1, 2).split(64, dim=-1)
+    bt, lens = ns.bt[:S], ns.seq_lens[:S]
+    max_len = max(case.lens)
+    if case.window:
+        nwb = spec.WINDOW // spec.KV_BLOCK + 1
+        builder = SimpleNamespace(
+            aot_sliding_window=(spec.WINDOW - 1, 0),
+            block_size=spec.KV_BLOCK,
+            _swa_block_table=torch.zeros(S, nwb, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+            _swa_seq_lens=torch.zeros(S, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+            _swa_block_offsets=torch.arange(nwb, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev),
+        )
+        table, lens, max_len = (
+            AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder._build_swa_decode_tables(  # noqa: E501
+                builder, bt, lens, S, max_len
+            )
+        )
+        sliding = spec.WINDOW
+    else:
+        table, sliding = bt, 0
+    parts = -(-max_len // _PARTITION_SIZE_ROCM)
+    work = torch.empty(
+        S * spec.HEADS * parts * 64 * 2 + 2 * S * spec.HEADS * parts * 4,
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=dev,
+    )
+    q = ns.qkvo[:, : spec.CORE].reshape(S, spec.HEADS, 64).contiguous()
+    out = torch.empty_like(q)
+    one = torch.ones(1, dtype=F32, device=dev)
+    # the kernel reads cu_query_lens[t + 1] (query_len = its difference): decode
+    # passes ``query_start_loc[:num_decodes]``, a view of the [S + 1] offsets,
+    # so the row past the end is real; a bare arange(S) reads past its end and
+    # a stale value > 1 there skips the row (output never written)
+    qsl = torch.arange(S + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)[:S]
+    torch.ops.aiter.paged_attention_v1(
+        out, work, q, key_cache, value_cache, spec.QK_SCALE, table,
+        qsl, lens, max_len, None,
+        "auto", "NHD", 0.0, one, one, None, _PARTITION_SIZE_ROCM, 1, sliding,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return out
+
+
+def row_ulps(got, ref) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """|got - ref| in bf16 ulps at the scale of each (token, head) row of
+    ``ref`` (its largest element's ulp). Element ulps are no measure here:
+    an output near zero (V cancelling) has a tiny ulp, and one bf16 rounding
+    of P -- stock's and the split's alike -- moves it by many."""
+    r = ref.double()
+    top = r.abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-30)
+    return (got.double() - r).abs() / torch.exp2(torch.floor(torch.log2(top)) - 7)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Every shipped K1 / K2 build compiles for gfx950 (GPU-less: FlyDSL's
+compile-only mode) through the runtime's own entry point
+(``runtime.layers.compile_build``) and passes the ISA gate of a persistent,
+all-resident kernel (design 5.13, DESIGN_BC 5.9): no private segment (a
+spilling kernel can lose residency and deadlock), at most 256 VGPRs (2 waves a
+SIMD), at most a CU's 160 KiB of LDS, and no readfirstlane waterfall (every
+mailbox and weight load has a wave-uniform buffer resource). A K1 build also
+holds one CTA a CU (more than 128 VGPRs or more than half a CU's LDS)."""
+
+import glob
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import regex as re
+import torch
+
+pytest.importorskip("flydsl")
+pytest.importorskip("aiter")
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import spec  # noqa: E402
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (  # noqa: E402
+    WAIT_TICKS,
+)
+
+
+def _compiles_for_gfx950() -> bool:
+    """A GPU-less compile must target gfx950: FlyDSL falls back to gfx942
+    without a device and then fails to select gfx950's permlane swaps."""
+    if (os.environ.get("FLYDSL_GPU_ARCH") or os.environ.get("ARCH")) == "gfx950":
+        return True
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+
+_W = range(1, spec.MAX_ROWS + 1)
+# every build the runtime serves (Phase A, B1's K1, B2's gated and C's split
+# cores, at every width and attention kind) and the stalled-rank fault build
+# test_numerics launches
+BUILDS = [
+    *(spec.K2Build(tokens=s) for s in _W),
+    spec.K2Build(
+        tokens=8,
+        fault_rank=3,
+        fault_epoch=2,
+        fault_slot=spec.k2_slot(1),
+        fault_ticks=WAIT_TICKS * 3 // 2,
+    ),
+    *(spec.K2Build(tokens=s, core="gated") for s in _W),
+    *(
+        spec.K2Build(tokens=s, core="split", window=w)
+        for s in _W
+        for w in (False, True)
+    ),
+    *(spec.K1Build(tokens=s, rope=r) for s in _W for r in (False, True)),
+]
+
+# a 64-bit compare of a VGPR buffer resource against its first lane's: a
+# readfirstlane waterfall around a load whose base is not wave-uniform
+_WATERFALL = re.compile(r"v_cmp_eq_u64_e\d+\s+\S+,\s*s\[\d+:\d+\],\s*v\[")
+
+
+def _resource(txt: str, name: str) -> int:
+    return int(re.search(rf"\.amdhsa_{name}\s+(\d+)", txt).group(1))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _compiles_for_gfx950(),
+    reason="GPU-less compile needs FLYDSL_GPU_ARCH=gfx950 (or a gfx950 GPU)",
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("key", BUILDS, ids=lambda k: k.kernel_name())
+def test_build_passes_the_isa_gate(key, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import k1, layer
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.layers import (
+        compile_build,
+    )
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("FLYDSL_RUNTIME_ENABLE_CACHE", "0")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("FLYDSL_DUMP_IR", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("FLYDSL_DUMP_DIR", str(tmp_path))
+    (k1 if isinstance(key, spec.K1Build) else layer)._BUILDS.pop(key, None)
+    try:
+        compile_build(key)
+    except RuntimeError as e:  # the load, past the compile, needs a device
+        if "hipErrorNoDevice" not in str(e) and "no ROCm" not in str(e):
+            raise
+    name = key.kernel_name()
+    for path in glob.glob(f"{tmp_path}/**/*final_isa.s", recursive=True):
+        with open(path) as f:
+            txt = f.read()
+        if re.search(rf"\.amdhsa_kernel {re.escape(name)}\b", txt):
+            break
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError(f"no final ISA of {name} under {tmp_path}")
+    vgpr = _resource(txt, "next_free_vgpr")
+    lds = _resource(txt, "group_segment_fixed_size")
+    assert _resource(txt, "private_segment_fixed_size") == 0, name
+    assert vgpr <= spec.VGPR_MAX, (name, vgpr)
+    assert lds <= spec.LDS_BYTES, (name, lds)
+    if isinstance(key, spec.K1Build):
+        assert vgpr > 128 or lds > spec.LDS_BYTES // 2, (name, vgpr, lds)
+    loops = _WATERFALL.findall(txt)
+    assert not loops, f"{name}: {len(loops)} waterfall compares, e.g. {loops[0]}"

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""K2 (one Muse Spark layer from the gated attention core to the deferred FFN
+boundary) on MI355X against the ops vLLM runs for the same decode step, random
+weights in the post-load formats at TP8 shapes.
+
+Each stage is checked tightly on its own inputs as the kernel saw them
+(the mailbox readbacks), so an eps, gain-center or order mistake in one stage
+cannot hide behind upstream noise; the chain (``moe``, ``branch_out``) against
+vLLM's stock decode. Every case has an eps-scaled row (the attention output,
+the pooled rows, one route's expert rows) and one case all-zero norm weights
+(gain ``w + 1``) with the last expert (the end of the experts' buffer
+resources) always picked; the base case at every width 1 .. 8. Then: the ranks agree
+bit for bit; one CUDA graph of two steps at two widths replayed 300 times on
+two input sets written in place in turn, every replay bit for bit the eager
+step on its own set; pad rows (NaN inputs)
+come out as exact zeros and leave the live rows unchanged; an all-pad step
+completes. And the fail-stop: a stalled rank fails the step without a hang.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from tests.models.muse_spark.amd_specialized_decode import reference as ref
+from tests.utils import (
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_gpu_test,
+    multi_process_parallel,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import spec
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import (
+    FAILED,
+    PEER_HEAD,
+    RECORD_WORDS,
+    STARTUP_WAIT_SECONDS,
+    WAIT_BUDGET,
+    WAIT_SECONDS,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+bf = torch.bfloat16
+f32 = torch.float32
+H, HM, CORE, INTER = spec.HIDDEN, spec.MOE_HIDDEN, spec.CORE, spec.INTER
+E, TOPK, TP, MT, MP = spec.EXPERTS, spec.TOPK, spec.TP, spec.MAX_TOKENS, spec.MAX_PICKS
+SLOT = spec.k2_slot(1)  # the first kernel layer's (layer 0 stays stock)
+STALLED = 3
+COS_STAGE = 0.99999
+COS_CHAIN = 0.9999
+REL_CHAIN = 1e-2
+CASES = ("base", "eps", "zero_w")
+WIDTHS = tuple(range(1, spec.MAX_ROWS + 1))
+REPLAYS = 300
+EPS_EXPERT = 17  # the "eps" case's forced expert, its w2 scaled by 2^-EPS_W2_SHIFT
+# unscaled, a route's R at these weights has mean square ~370 (CPU reference,
+# 8 ranks): 2^-17 puts mean((R (w + 1))^2) at ~2e-8, i.e. at POST_EXP_EPS
+EPS_W2_SHIFT = 17
+# the "zero_w" case's forced expert: the last one, whose w13 / w13s / w2 / w2s
+# end exactly at their buffer resources' num_records (stages/experts.py)
+LAST_EXPERT = E - 1
+
+
+def _on_gfx950() -> bool:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()

+
+needs_gfx950 = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_gfx950(), reason="the Muse mono kernels need gfx950 (MI355X)"
+)
+
+
+# The host readback of the mailbox regions.
+
+
+def _region(runner, name: str) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
+    """(byte buffer, byte offset) of ``name`` as the kernels address it: a
+    scratch region, or a peer region in the current epoch's parity half."""
+    lay = spec.scratch_layout()
+    if name in lay:
+        return runner.scratch, lay[name][0]
+    e = int(runner.epoch.item()) & spec.EPOCH_MASK
+    off = PEER_HEAD + (e & 1) * spec.peer_half_bytes() + spec.peer_layout()[name][0]
+    return runner.peers.bytes, off
+
+
+def _pairs(runner, name: str, index: int, n: int):
+    """(values, tags) of pairs ``index`` .. ``index + n`` of region ``name``
+    (host copies; ``.view(torch.float32)`` an fp32 payload, two bf16 a packed
+    one)."""
+    buf, off = _region(runner, name)
+    off += 8 * index
+    assert off % 8 == 0 and off + 8 * n <= buf.numel(), (name, off, n)
+    pairs = buf[off : off + 8 * n].view(torch.int32).view(n, 2)
+    return pairs[:, 0].cpu(), pairs[:, 1].cpu()
+
+
+def _tag(runner) -> int:
+    return spec.step_tag(int(runner.epoch.item()), SLOT)
+
+
+def _owner_sum(part: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A rank's 32 owner slices [..., 32] summed in ``stage_owner``'s fp32
+    order: lane rp the 4 slices 4 rp .. in order, then the butterfly over the
+    8 lanes (xor 4, 2, 1), which every lane ends with (lane 0's order)."""
+    lane = part[..., 0::4] + part[..., 1::4]
+    lane = (lane + part[..., 2::4]) + part[..., 3::4]  # [..., 8]: lane rp
+    for off in (4, 2, 1):
+        lane = lane + lane[..., [rp ^ off for rp in range(8)]]
+    return lane[..., 0]
+
+
+def readback(runner, S: int) -> dict:
+    """Every mailbox region of the last launch (rows < S), decoded, and the
+    tags each pair carried: ``ar`` bf16 [TP, S, H] (src's partial), ``ass`` /
+    ``bss`` fp32 [NA, S], ``rlog`` fp32 [S, E] (expert 32 src + i), ``route``
+    (ids int32 [S, 8], weights fp32), ``pool`` bf16 [S, HM], ``rsx`` bf16 [TP,
+    S, 8, OWN_COLS] (src's down rows of this rank's columns), ``sqx_part``
+    fp32 [TP, RED_TASKS, S, 8] (src's owner CTA j's 16 columns), ``sqx`` fp32
+    [TP, S, 8] (src's 512 columns, summed as the kernel does), ``moe`` bf16 [S,
+    HM], ``branch`` bf16 [S, H]; plain ``xrow`` bf16 [S, H]."""
+    out, tags = {}, {}
+
+    def rows(name, n_rows, row_pairs):
+        v, t = _pairs(runner, name, 0, n_rows * row_pairs)
+        tags[name] = t.view(n_rows, row_pairs)
+        return v.view(n_rows, row_pairs)
+
+    out["ar"] = rows("ar", TP * MT, H // 2).view(TP, MT, H // 2)[:, :S]
+    tags["ar"] = tags["ar"].view(TP, MT, -1)[:, :S]
+    out["ar"] = out["ar"].contiguous().view(bf).view(TP, S, H)
+    for name in ("ass", "bss"):
+        v = rows(name, spec.NA, MT)
+        out[name] = v[:, :S].contiguous().view(f32)
+        tags[name] = tags[name][:, :S]
+    v = rows("rlog", TP * MT, spec.EXPERTS_RANK).view(TP, MT, -1)[:, :S]
+    tags["rlog"] = tags["rlog"].view(TP, MT, -1)[:, :S]
+    out["rlog"] = v.contiguous().view(f32).permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(S, E)
+    v = rows("route", MT, 16)[:S]
+    tags["route"] = tags["route"][:S]
+    out["ids"] = v[:, :TOPK].clone()
+    out["tw"] = v[:, TOPK:].contiguous().view(f32)
+    for name, width in (("pool", HM), ("moe", HM), ("branch", H)):
+        v = rows(name, MT, width // 2)[:S]
+        tags[name] = tags[name][:S]
+        out[name] = v.contiguous().view(bf).view(S, width)
+    v = rows("rsx", TP * MP, spec.OWN_COLS // 2).view(TP, MP, -1)[:, : S * TOPK]
+    tags["rsx"] = tags["rsx"].view(TP, MP, -1)[:, : S * TOPK]
+    out["rsx"] = v.contiguous().view(bf).view(TP, S, TOPK, spec.OWN_COLS)
+    v = rows("sqx", TP * MP, spec.RED_TASKS).view(TP, MP, -1)[:, : S * TOPK]
+    tags["sqx"] = tags["sqx"].view(TP, MP, -1)[:, : S * TOPK]
+    part = v.contiguous().view(f32).view(TP, S, TOPK, spec.RED_TASKS)
+    out["sqx_part"] = part.permute(0, 3, 1, 2).contiguous()
+    out["sqx"] = _owner_sum(part)
+    lay = spec.scratch_layout()
+    o = lay[spec.XROW][0]
+    xrow = runner.scratch[o : o + spec.XROW_BYTES].cpu().view(bf).view(MT, H)
+    out["xrow"] = xrow[:S].clone()
+    out["tags"] = tags
+    return out
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- [TP8]

+
+def _init_worker(monkeypatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+    return device
+
+
+def _gemm(x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The unquantized GEMM dispatch of vLLM (``rocm_unquantized_gemm`` on gfx950),
+    as ``UnquantizedLinearMethod.apply`` runs a linear layer's weight: the o_proj
+    reference only."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.utils import dispatch_unquantized_gemm
+
+    return dispatch_unquantized_gemm()(torch.nn.Module(), x, w, None)
+
+
+def _linear(x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The pooler's and the unpooler's GEMM: a plain ``F.linear``, as
+    ``MuseSparkTorchLinearMethod`` runs them (amd/model.py: not the AITER
+    tuned-GEMM dispatch, whose split-K kernels accumulate in bf16)."""
+    return torch.nn.functional.linear(x, w)
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _tp_checks(what: str):
+    """Rank-local checks as one TP verdict. A check that fails on some ranks
+    only must not leave the others in the next collective: vLLM's custom
+    all-reduce and NCCL spin with no timeout, and the exclusive node hangs.
+    Every rank enters and leaves the block at the same point; on exit the ranks
+    vote over the TP CPU (gloo) group and all raise if any failed (the failing
+    ranks their own error). No collective inside the block."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.peer import tp_agree
+
+    err: Exception | None = None
+    try:
+        yield
+    except Exception as e:  # voted below, then raised on every rank
+        err = e
+    if not tp_agree(err is None, get_tp_group().cpu_group):
+        if err is not None:
+            raise err
+        raise AssertionError(f"another TP rank failed {what}")
+
+
+def _weights(rank: int, device, case: str = "base") -> dict:
+    """One rank's K2 weights (post-load formats; replicated tensors from seed
+    7, the rank's shards from 100 + rank) and the experts' unshuffled bytes
+    and codes (``ckpt``). ``eps``: the pooler scaled so mean(pooled^2) ~
+    PRE_EXP_EPS, expert EPS_EXPERT always picked and its w2 scaled by
+    2^-EPS_W2_SHIFT (that route's mean square ~ POST_EXP_EPS), the residual
+    gate -2.5 (beta ~ 2.4e-4, see ``_inputs``). ``zero_w``:
+    every norm weight zero, expert LAST_EXPERT always picked."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.layers import (
+        MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection,
+    )
+
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(7)
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(100 + rank)
+
+    def rn(g, *shape, s=1.0, dtype=bf):
+        return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=device) * s).to(dtype)
+
+    def u8(g, *shape, lo=0, hi=256):
+        return torch.randint(
+            lo, hi, shape, generator=g, device=device, dtype=torch.int64
+        ).to(torch.uint8)
+
+    conn = MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection(H).to(device)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        conn.gate.copy_(rn(gc, H, dtype=f32))
+        if case == "eps":
+            # beta = sigmoid(-2.5 / 0.3) ~ 2.4e-4 (alpha ~ 1) on every channel:
+            # the pre-FFN norm's input of a row with a small stream is small
+            # too (``_inputs``)
+            conn.gate.fill_(-2.5)
+    conn.materialize_coefficients()
+    w = {
+        "attn_alpha": conn.alpha.contiguous(),
+        "attn_beta": conn.beta.contiguous(),
+        "w_preffn": rn(gc, H, s=0.1),
+        # the router multiplier folded in (0.1768) at load
+        "w_router": rn(gc, E, H, s=0.02 * 0.1768, dtype=f32),
+        "bias": rn(gc, E, s=0.02, dtype=f32),
+        "w_pool": rn(gc, HM, H, s=H**-0.5),
+        "w_preexp": rn(gc, HM, s=0.1),
+        "w_postexp": rn(gc, HM, s=0.1),
+        "w_unpool": rn(gc, H, HM, s=HM**-0.5),
+        "w_o": rn(gr, H, CORE, s=(TP * CORE) ** -0.5),
+    }
+    w13 = u8(gr, E, 2 * INTER, HM // 2)
+    c13 = u8(gr, E, 2 * INTER, HM // 32, lo=118, hi=123)
+    w2 = u8(gr, E, HM, INTER // 2)
+    c2 = u8(gr, E, HM, INTER // 32, lo=118, hi=123)
+    if case == "eps":
+        w["w_pool"] = (w["w_pool"].float() * 3e-3).to(bf)
+        w["bias"][EPS_EXPERT] = 10.0
+        c2[EPS_EXPERT] -= EPS_W2_SHIFT
+    if case == "zero_w":
+        for n in ("w_preffn", "w_preexp", "w_postexp"):
+            w[n] = torch.zeros_like(w[n])
+        w["bias"][LAST_EXPERT] = 10.0
+
+    def shuf_scale(c):
+        # e8m0_shuffle on the [E N, K / 32] view of the uint8 codes, the dtype
+        # Quark loads them in (oracle/mxfp4.py AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4 branch): the
+        # stock MoE gets exactly the tensor the served layer holds
+        s0, s1, n = c.shape
+        return e8m0_shuffle(c.reshape(s0 * s1, n)).view(s0, s1, -1).contiguous()
+
+    w["w13"] = shuffle_weight(w13, layout=(16, 16)).contiguous()
+    w["w2"] = shuffle_weight(w2, layout=(16, 16)).contiguous()
+    # the stock MoE takes typed views (fp4x2 weights, e8m0 scales); the
+    # kernel the same bytes by address
+    w["w13_fp4"] = w["w13"].view(torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2)
+    w["w2_fp4"] = w["w2"].view(torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2)
+    # as oracle/mxfp4.py marks the loaded weights: aiter's fused_moe picks its
+    # kernel (and the weight layout it assumes) from this attribute
+    w["w13_fp4"].is_shuffled = True
+    w["w2_fp4"].is_shuffled = True
+    w["w13s"] = shuf_scale(c13)
+    w["w2s"] = shuf_scale(c2)
+    w["ckpt"] = (w13, c13, w2, c2)
+    return w
+
+
+def _inputs(rank: int, device, S: int, case: str = "base", seed: int = 0):
+    """(core [S, CORE] bf16 of this rank, stream [S, H] fp32 replicated);
+    ``seed`` picks another set of the same width. The
+    "eps" case scales row 0's core on every rank by 1e-4: mean(attn_out^2) ~
+    POST_ATTN_EPS; and the last row's stream by 3e-3: with that case's beta ~
+    2.4e-4 the pre-FFN norm's input alpha stream + beta y has mean square
+    ~9e-6 ~ PRE_FFN_EPS."""
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(11 + S + 1000 * seed)
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(200 + 8 * S + rank + 1000 * seed)
+    core = torch.randn(S, CORE, generator=gr, device=device)
+    if case == "eps":
+        core[0] *= 1e-4
+    stream = torch.randn(S, H, generator=gc, device=device)
+    if case == "eps":
+        stream[S - 1] *= 3e-3
+    return core.to(bf), stream
+
+
+def _pad(device, rows=()) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The pad flags: whole words (``ld_pad`` reads the word of a row's byte)."""
+    p = torch.zeros(16, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    for r in rows:
+        p[r] = True
+    return p
+
+
+KERNEL_WEIGHTS = (
+    "w_o",
+    "attn_alpha",
+    "attn_beta",
+    "w_preffn",
+    "w_router",
+    "bias",
+    "w_pool",
+    "w_preexp",
+    "w13",
+    "w13s",
+    "w2",
+    "w2s",
+    "w_postexp",
+    "w_unpool",
+)
+
+
+def _launch(runner, w, core, stream, pad, key=None, *, begin=True):
+    """One K2 step (the epoch bumped first): -> (stream_out, branch_out)."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layer
+
+    S = core.shape[0]
+    key = key or spec.K2Build(tokens=S, **runner.fault)
+    stream_out = torch.empty_like(stream)
+    branch_out = torch.empty(S, H, dtype=bf, device=stream.device)
+    if begin:
+        runner.step_begin()
+    layer.k2_launch(
+        key,
+        {
+            **{n: w[n] for n in KERNEL_WEIGHTS},
+            "core": core,
+            "stream": stream,
+            "pad": pad,
+            "stream_out": stream_out,
+            "branch_out": branch_out,
+            "slot": SLOT,
+            **runner.launch_args(),
+            **runner.peer_args(),
+        },
+    )
+    return stream_out, branch_out
+
+
+def _assert_healthy(runner) -> None:
+    """No wait gave up, no alarm: FAILED and every CTA's record zero (the
+    header's WAIT_BUDGET word holds the budget), the output rank's flags 0.
+    Collective (``_tp_checks``): only the output rank's flags are ever set
+    (``runner.alarm``), so the local verdicts differ by construction."""
+    with _tp_checks("the health check"):
+        h = runner.health.cpu().clone()
+        assert h[FAILED] == 0, h[RECORD_WORDS:].view(-1, RECORD_WORDS).nonzero()
+        h[WAIT_BUDGET] = 0
+        assert not h.any()
+        assert not runner.flags.any()
+
+
+def _gather(x: torch.Tensor) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    out = [torch.empty_like(x) for _ in range(TP)]
+    dist.all_gather(out, x.contiguous())
+    return out
+
+
+def _all_ranks_equal(x: torch.Tensor, what: str) -> None:
+    """Every rank gathers the same tensors, so the verdict is the same on every
+    rank (no vote needed)."""
+    outs = _gather(x)
+    assert all(torch.equal(outs[0], o) for o in outs), f"ranks disagree on {what}"
+
+
+def _stock_boundary(attn, stream, w):
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_rmsnorm import (
+        fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd,
+    )
+
+    ffn_in, stream_out = fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd(
+        attn,
+        stream,
+        None,
+        w["w_preffn"],
+        spec.POST_ATTN_EPS,
+        spec.PRE_FFN_EPS,
+        alpha=w["attn_alpha"],
+        beta=w["attn_beta"],
+        post_gain_center=0.0,
+        pre_gain_center=spec.GAIN,
+        out_dtype=bf,
+    )
+    return ffn_in, stream_out
+
+
+def _route_ids(ids: torch.Tensor, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The kernel's picks (``route`` readback, pads -1) as the stock MoE's
+    ``[S 8, 1]`` int32 ids, a pad row's picks on expert 0 (only live rows are
+    compared)."""
+    flat = ids.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int32).clamp(min=0)
+    return flat.reshape(-1, 1).contiguous()
+
+
+def _stock_experts(ffn_in, flat_ids, tw, w, unit=None):
+    """The routed experts vLLM runs, on ``ffn_in`` with the given picks
+    (``flat_ids`` int32 [S 8, 1] on the device: the kernel's, so routing cannot
+    differ): pooler, the expanded pre-expert norm, vLLM's AITER MoE op with the
+    arguments ``rocm_aiter_fused_experts`` passes for Muse's MXFP4 w4a4 layers
+    (one unit-weight top-1 route a row, as ``MuseSparkAiterExperts.apply``
+    calls it), the rank-sum in fp32, the post-expert finalize.
+    ``unit``: the cached ones buffer (``MuseSparkAiterExperts._unit_weights``),
+    allocated here when None. -> (rows bf16 [S, 8, HM] of this rank, moe bf16
+    [S, HM])."""
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.rocm_aiter_moe import (
+        ActivationMethod,
+        QuantMethod,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.ops.fused_norm_expand import (
+        fused_rmsnorm_expand,
+        take_expanded,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_finalize import (
+        fused_post_expert_finalize,
+    )
+
+    S = ffn_in.shape[0]
+    xe = fused_rmsnorm_expand(
+        _linear(ffn_in, w["w_pool"]),
+        w["w_preexp"],
+        spec.PRE_EXP_EPS,
+        spec.GAIN,
+        False,
+        TOPK,
+    )
+    expanded = take_expanded(xe, TOPK)
+    if unit is None:
+        unit = torch.ones(S * TOPK, 1, dtype=f32, device=ffn_in.device)
+    # rocm_aiter_fused_experts for Muse (MXFP4 w4a4, SiLU, no bias, no pads:
+    # hidden_pad = intermediate_pad = 0, gate_mode "" = AITER's "separated")
+    rows = rocm_aiter_ops.fused_moe(
+        expanded,
+        w["w13_fp4"],
+        w["w2_fp4"],
+        unit,
+        flat_ids,
+        activation_method=ActivationMethod.SILU.value,
+        quant_method=QuantMethod.BLOCK_1X32.value,
+        w1_scale=w["w13s"],
+        w2_scale=w["w2s"],
+        output_dtype=bf,
+        moe_sorting_dispatch_policy=rocm_aiter_ops.get_moe_dispatch_policy(),
+        swiglu_limit=0.0,
+    ).view(S, TOPK, HM)
+    R = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(rows.float())
+    moe = torch.empty(S, HM, dtype=bf, device=ffn_in.device)
+    fused_post_expert_finalize(
+        R, w["w_postexp"], tw, spec.POST_EXP_EPS, spec.GAIN, True, moe
+    )
+    return rows, moe
+
+
+def _eps_bites(ms: torch.Tensor, eps: float, other: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """How much the norm scale ``rsqrt(m + eps)`` of rows with mean square
+    ``ms`` moves when ``eps`` is swapped for ``other`` (a factor >= 1)."""
+    ms = ms.double()
+    hi, lo = max(eps, other), min(eps, other)
+    return torch.sqrt((ms + hi) / (ms + lo))
+
+
+def _assert_eps_rows_bite(attn_k, stream_out, rb, R, w) -> None:
+    """The "eps" case's premise (design 6.2 (i)): its scaled rows sit where a
+    swapped 1e-8 / 1e-5 eps moves the norm by O(1), so the tight per-stage
+    checks would catch the swap -- the attention output's row 0, the pre-FFN
+    norm's input of the last row, the pooled rows, the forced expert's routes.
+    A calibration that misses this makes the case vacuous, so it fails here
+    instead of passing silently."""
+    big, small = spec.PRE_FFN_EPS, spec.POST_ATTN_EPS  # 1e-5, 1e-8
+    a = attn_k[0].double().square().mean()
+    assert _eps_bites(a, small, big).item() > 1.25, ("attn row 0", a.item())
+    n = stream_out[-1].double().square().mean()
+    assert _eps_bites(n, big, small).item() > 1.25, ("pre-FFN last row", n.item())
+    pm = rb["pool"].double().square().mean(-1)
+    assert (_eps_bites(pm, big, small) > 1.25).all(), ("pooled rows", pm)
+    hit = (rb["ids"] == EPS_EXPERT).to(R.device)
+    x = R.double() * (w["w_postexp"].double() + spec.GAIN)
+    xm = x.square().mean(-1)[hit]
+    assert xm.numel() > 0 and (_eps_bites(xm, small, big) > 1.25).all(), (
+        "forced route",
+        xm,
+    )
+
+
+def _check_step(runner, w, core, stream, pad, stream_out, branch_out, case) -> dict:
+    """Every stage of the last launch against vLLM's ops on the inputs the
+    kernel saw (design 6.2); returns the readback. The checks are rank-local
+    (each rank its own shard) and the references collective, so every check
+    block is voted (``_tp_checks``) before the next collective."""
+    from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.rocm_fp32_router_gemm import (
+        rocm_fp32_router_gemm,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_finalize import (
+        fused_post_expert_finalize,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_routing import (
+        fused_musespark1x_routing,
+    )
+
+    dev = core.device
+    rank = runner.rank
+    S = core.shape[0]
+    p = pad[:S].cpu()
+    live = ~p
+    lv = live.to(dev)
+    where = f"{case} S={S}"
+    _assert_healthy(runner)
+    rb = readback(runner, S)
+    tag = _tag(runner)
+    # ---- o_proj: this rank's partial vs the stock GEMM; attn_out = the
+    # partials in rank order (the seam's input), vs the stock all-reduce
+    part = _gemm(core, w["w_o"])
+    with _tp_checks(f"{where}: tags, o_proj"):
+        for name, t in rb["tags"].items():
+            assert (t == tag).all(), (case, S, name, t[t != tag][:4])
+        # pad rows: the kernel pushes zeros (load_core selects them), stock
+        # computes them
+        ref.check_gemv(
+            rb["ar"][rank][live], part[lv], core[lv], w["w_o"], what=f"{case} o_proj"
+        )
+        assert (rb["ar"][:, p].float() == 0).all(), case
+    attn_k = ref.attn_out(list(rb["ar"])).to(dev)
+    attn_stock = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(part.clone())
+    _all_ranks_equal(rb["ar"].to(dev), "ar")
+    with _tp_checks(f"{where}: boundary, router, routing, pooler"):
+        assert ref.cos(attn_k[lv], attn_stock[lv]) > COS_STAGE
+        # the seam's sums of squares: the 64 slices' partials
+        ss = attn_k.double().square().sum(-1).cpu()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            rb["ass"].double().sum(0)[live], ss[live], rtol=1e-5, atol=0
+        )
+        # ---- boundary on the kernel's own attn_out
+        ffn_ref, stream_ref = _stock_boundary(attn_k, stream, w)
+        got_s, ref_s = stream_out.cpu(), stream_ref.cpu()
+        x = attn_k.float().cpu()
+        y = x * torch.rsqrt(x.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + spec.POST_ATTN_EPS)
+        mag = (w["attn_alpha"].cpu() * stream.cpu()).abs() + (
+            w["attn_beta"].cpu() * y
+        ).abs()
+        err = (got_s - ref_s).abs()
+        assert (err[live] <= 1e-5 * mag[live] + 1e-30).all(), (case, err[live].max())
+        assert (got_s[p] == 0).all()
+        ns = got_s.double()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            rb["bss"].double().sum(0)[live],
+            ns.square().sum(-1)[live],
+            rtol=1e-5,
+            atol=0,
+        )
+        rs = torch.rsqrt(ns.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + spec.PRE_FFN_EPS)
+        own = (ns * rs * (w["w_preffn"].cpu().double() + spec.GAIN)).float().to(bf)
+        assert ref.bf16_ulps(rb["xrow"][live], own[live]).max() <= 1, case
+        u = ref.bf16_ulps(rb["xrow"][live], ffn_ref.cpu()[live])
+        assert (u == 0).float().mean().item() >= 0.999, case
+        big = ref_s.abs() >= 1e-3 * mag
+        assert (u[big[live]] <= 1).all(), case
+        assert (rb["xrow"][p].float() == 0).all()
+        # chain guard: against the stock all-reduce's boundary
+        _, stream_stock = _stock_boundary(attn_stock, stream, w)
+        assert ref.cos(got_s[live], stream_stock.cpu()[live]) > COS_STAGE
+        # ---- router logits on the kernel's own ffn_in: the README
+        # tolerance, except where the two fp32 orders differ only by
+        # accumulation noise on a cancelling dot
+        xrow = rb["xrow"].to(dev)
+        logits = rocm_fp32_router_gemm(xrow, w["w_router"]).cpu()
+        absdot = rb["xrow"].double().abs() @ w["w_router"].double().abs().T.cpu()
+        close = torch.isclose(rb["rlog"], logits, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
+        noise = (rb["rlog"].double() - logits.double()).abs() <= 2**-20 * absdot
+        assert (close | noise)[live].all(), (case, "router")
+        assert close[live].float().mean().item() >= 0.99, (case, "router")
+        # ---- routing on the kernel's own logits
+        tw_s, ids_s = fused_musespark1x_routing(
+            rb["rlog"].to(dev),
+            w["bias"],
+            TOPK,
+            spec.ROUTE_SCALE,
+            router_score_division_eps=spec.ROUTE_EPS,
+            is_padding=pad[:S].contiguous(),
+        )
+        assert torch.equal(rb["ids"], ids_s.cpu()), case
+        assert torch.equal(rb["tw"], tw_s.cpu().float()), case
+        if case == "eps":
+            assert (rb["ids"][live] == EPS_EXPERT).any(-1).all()
+        if case == "zero_w":
+            assert (rb["ids"][live] == LAST_EXPERT).any(-1).all()
+        # ---- pooler on the kernel's own ffn_in
+        pooled = _linear(xrow, w["w_pool"]).cpu()
+        ref.check_gemv(
+            rb["pool"][live],
+            pooled[live],
+            rb["xrow"][live].float(),
+            w["w_pool"].cpu(),
+            what=f"{case} pool",
+        )
+        assert ref.cos(rb["pool"][live], pooled[live]) > COS_STAGE
+    # ---- the owner reduce: R = the 8 ranks' rows of this rank's columns in
+    # rank order (fp32, never rounded); the finalize on the gathered R
+    R_own = ref.owner_sum(list(rb["rsx"].float()))  # [S, 8, 512]
+    R = torch.cat(_gather(R_own.to(dev)), -1)  # [S, 8, HM], rank r's 512 r ..
+    with _tp_checks(f"{where}: owner reduce, finalize"):
+        sq = ref.owner_sumsq(R.cpu(), w["w_postexp"].cpu())
+        for src in range(TP):
+            lo = src * spec.OWN_COLS
+            part_sq = ref.owner_sumsq(
+                R[..., lo : lo + spec.OWN_COLS].cpu(),
+                w["w_postexp"][lo : lo + spec.OWN_COLS].cpu(),
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                rb["sqx"][src][live], part_sq[live], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-30
+            )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            rb["sqx"].double().sum(0)[live], sq.double()[live], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-30
+        )
+        # this rank's 32 owner slices (16 columns each), as every rank got them
+        for jj in range(spec.RED_TASKS):
+            c0 = rank * spec.OWN_COLS + jj * spec.ROWS
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                rb["sqx_part"][rank][jj][live],
+                ref.owner_sumsq(
+                    R[..., c0 : c0 + spec.ROWS].cpu(),
+                    w["w_postexp"][c0 : c0 + spec.ROWS].cpu(),
+                ),
+                rtol=1e-5,
+                atol=1e-30,
+            )
+        moe_ref = torch.empty(S, HM, dtype=bf, device=dev)
+        fused_post_expert_finalize(
+            R,
+            w["w_postexp"],
+            rb["tw"].to(dev),
+            spec.POST_EXP_EPS,
+            spec.GAIN,
+            True,
+            moe_ref,
+        )
+        ref.check_ulps(rb["moe"][live], moe_ref.cpu()[live], what=f"{case} finalize")
+        assert (rb["moe"][p].float() == 0).all()
+        if case == "eps":
+            _assert_eps_rows_bite(attn_k, got_s, rb, R, w)
+    # ---- the experts' chain (stock MoE on the kernel's ffn_in and picks)
+    rows_s, moe_s = _stock_experts(
+        xrow, _route_ids(rb["ids"], dev), rb["tw"].to(dev), w
+    )
+    mine = rb["rsx"].to(dev)  # [src, t, k, this rank's 512]: src's rows
+    # every rank's stock rows (its expert shard), then this rank's columns:
+    # rsx[src] holds src's rows of the columns THIS rank owns
+    lo = rank * spec.OWN_COLS
+    rows_all = torch.stack(_gather(rows_s.contiguous()))[..., lo : lo + spec.OWN_COLS]
+    moe_k = rb["moe"].to(dev)
+    with _tp_checks(f"{where}: experts, unpooler"):
+        assert ref.cos(mine[:, lv], rows_all[:, lv]) > COS_CHAIN, case
+        assert ref.cos(moe_k[lv], moe_s[lv]) > COS_CHAIN, case
+        assert ref.rel_l2(moe_k[lv], moe_s[lv]) < REL_CHAIN, case
+        # ---- unpooler on the kernel's own moe; gather = the branch rows
+        branch = _linear(moe_k, w["w_unpool"]).cpu()
+        ref.check_gemv(
+            branch_out.cpu()[live],
+            branch[live],
+            rb["moe"][live].float(),
+            w["w_unpool"].cpu(),
+            what=f"{case} unpool",
+        )
+        assert torch.equal(branch_out.cpu(), rb["branch"]), case
+        assert (branch_out.cpu()[p].float() == 0).all()
+        branch_s = _linear(moe_s, w["w_unpool"])
+        assert ref.cos(branch_out[lv], branch_s[lv]) > COS_CHAIN, case
+        assert ref.rel_l2(branch_out[lv], branch_s[lv]) < REL_CHAIN, case
+    # ---- every rank the same rows
+    for name, t in (
+        ("stream_out", stream_out),
+        ("branch_out", branch_out),
+        ("xrow", xrow),
+        ("route", torch.cat([rb["ids"], rb["tw"].view(torch.int32)], -1).to(dev)),

+def _stock_span(w, core, stream, pad, out: dict, unit: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """The decode vLLM runs from o_proj's input to the unpooler's output (design
+    7.0): o_proj + all-reduce, the boundary, the router GEMM and routing, the
+    pooler, the expanded pre-expert norm, aiter's MoE, the fp32 all-reduce,
+    the finalize, the unpooler -- and nothing else: the routing's ids go to the
+    MoE as a view and ``unit`` is the experts' cached ones buffer, as in the
+    served layer. Writes ``out["stream"]``, ``out["branch"]``."""
+    from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.rocm_fp32_router_gemm import (
+        rocm_fp32_router_gemm,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_routing import (
+        fused_musespark1x_routing,
+    )
+
+    S = core.shape[0]
+    attn = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(_gemm(core, w["w_o"]))
+    ffn_in, stream_out = _stock_boundary(attn, stream, w)
+    logits = rocm_fp32_router_gemm(ffn_in, w["w_router"])
+    tw, ids = fused_musespark1x_routing(
+        logits,
+        w["bias"],
+        TOPK,
+        spec.ROUTE_SCALE,
+        router_score_division_eps=spec.ROUTE_EPS,
+        is_padding=pad[:S],
+    )
+    _, moe = _stock_experts(ffn_in, ids.view(S * TOPK, 1), tw, w, unit)
+    out["stream"] = stream_out
+    out["branch"] = _linear(moe, w["w_unpool"])
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _k2_worker(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tp_size: int,
+    pp_size: int,
+    rank: int,
+    distributed_init_port: str,
+) -> None:
+    device = _init_worker(monkeypatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.runner import MonoRunner
+
+    runner = MonoRunner(device)
+    # the first launch of each build compiles it: the startup budget
+    runner.set_wait_budget(STARTUP_WAIT_SECONDS)
+    for case in CASES:
+        w = _weights(rank, device, case)
+        # every served width (a partial, guarded second round of load_xq's
+        # groups and load_inter's ISC codes runs only at S = 5 .. 7); the eps
+        # and zero_w premises at both ends
+        for S in WIDTHS if case == "base" else (1, MT):
+            core, stream = _inputs(rank, device, S, case)
+            pad = _pad(device)
+            stream_out, branch_out = _launch(runner, w, core, stream, pad)
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+            _check_step(runner, w, core, stream, pad, stream_out, branch_out, case)
+
+    # Pad rows (NaN / Inf inputs) come out as exact zeros and leave the live
+    # rows unchanged
+    w = _weights(rank, device)
+    core, stream = _inputs(rank, device, 8)
+    pad = _pad(device, (5, 6, 7))
+    clean_s, clean_b = _launch(runner, w, core, stream, pad)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    _assert_healthy(runner)
+    _check_step(runner, w, core, stream, pad, clean_s, clean_b, "pad")
+    dirty_c, dirty_s = core.clone(), stream.clone()
+    dirty_c[5:] = float("nan")
+    dirty_s[5:] = float("nan")
+    dirty_c[6, 3] = float("inf")
+    got_s, got_b = _launch(runner, w, dirty_c, dirty_s, pad)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    _assert_healthy(runner)
+    with _tp_checks("the NaN pad rows"):
+        assert (got_s[5:] == 0).all() and (got_b[5:].float() == 0).all()
+        assert torch.equal(got_s[:5], clean_s[:5])
+        assert torch.equal(got_b[:5], clean_b[:5])
+        rb = readback(runner, 8)
+        assert (rb["ids"][5:] == -1).all() and (rb["tw"][5:] == 0).all()
+        assert (rb["moe"][5:].float() == 0).all()
+    # every row a pad row (a capture warm-up's step): nothing in the union,
+    # the launch completes with zero outputs
+    for S in (1, 8):
+        core, stream = _inputs(rank, device, S)
+        all_pad = torch.ones(16, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+        s_out, b_out = _launch(runner, w, core, stream, all_pad)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        _assert_healthy(runner)
+        with _tp_checks(f"the all-pad step S={S}"):
+            assert (s_out == 0).all() and (b_out.float() == 0).all(), S
+
+    # One CUDA graph of two steps at two widths (each step's epoch bump
+    # captured with it), replayed on two input sets written in place in turn:
+    # every replay matches the eager step on its own set. A wait that took a
+    # stale tag of the same parity (two epochs back: the previous replay's)
+    # would read the other set's rows, which identical inputs would hide.
+    sets = [{S: _inputs(rank, device, S, seed=k) for S in (1, MT)} for k in (0, 1)]
+    pad = _pad(device)
+    # the eager references (and the warm-ups: code objects loaded)
+    want = [{S: _launch(runner, w, *sets[k][S], pad) for S in (1, MT)} for k in (0, 1)]
+    ins = {S: tuple(t.clone() for t in sets[0][S]) for S in (1, MT)}
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    outs = {}
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        for S in (1, MT):
+            outs[S] = _launch(runner, w, *ins[S], pad)
+    bad = torch.zeros(REPLAYS, 2, 2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    for i in range(REPLAYS):
+        k = i % 2
+        for S in (1, MT):
+            for dst, src in zip(ins[S], sets[k][S]):
+                dst.copy_(src)
+        graph.replay()
+        for j, S in enumerate((1, MT)):
+            for o, (got, ref_out) in enumerate(zip(outs[S], want[k][S])):
+                bad[i, j, o] = (got != ref_out).any()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    with _tp_checks("the graph replays"):
+        # (replay, width index, output: stream_out 0 / branch_out 1)
+        assert not bad.any(), bad.nonzero()[:8].tolist()
+    _assert_healthy(runner)
+

+    )

+    runner.fault = {

+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    waits = given_up_waits(runner.health.cpu(), spec.REGIONS)
+    gave_up = torch.tensor([int(bool(waits))], device=device)
+    dist.all_reduce(gave_up)
+    assert gave_up.item() > 0, "no rank's wait gave up"
+    if rank == 0:

+"""K2(split) (``K2Build(core="split")``, the in-kernel split-KV attention
+core, DESIGN_BC 7, WP-C3) at TP8 against the decode vLLM runs, real shapes,
+random weights in the post-load formats.
+
+The front is the stock one (``fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd``, the qkv GEMM as
+served, the fused QK-norm / RoPE / KV insert into the layer's cache) or K1
+(``mono/k1.py``, Phase B1). Every step runs
+the same front twice on two copies of the cache: once into the stock core
+(``paged_attention_v1``, a sliding layer on ``_build_swa_decode_tables``'
+window-trimmed table) and K2(gated) (B6: bit for bit K2(tensor) on vLLM's
+gated core), once into K2(split). The metadata is MRV2's persistent buffers
+(``reference.FakeMrv2``: one full and one sliding KV group, each its own
+block table and slot mapping, a sliding table nulled below the window).
+
+[TP8] ``test_layer_chain_split``: on the live rows the split core's gated rows
+(``xo``) agree with ``rms_norm_gated`` of the stock attention (cos) and are
+never further from the fp64 gated attention than stock's (E9);
+``stream_out`` agrees with the K2(gated) step and with vLLM's stock span from
+the stock gated core (cos 0.99999); the tail is Phase A's (``stream_out`` and
+``branch_out`` bit for bit K2(tensor) on the split core's own gated rows) and
+``branch_out`` agrees with vLLM's experts on its own ffn_in rows and picks
+(cos 0.9999, Phase A's reference, DESIGN_BC 9.3; the whole chain's branch is
+printed: the stock span itself moves to cos ~0.99 between the two cores);
+the pad rows are exact zeros, and NaN in their qkv rows changes nothing; the
+ranks agree bit for bit; the cache bytes after the split step equal the gated
+step's (the split core never writes the cache); no wait gave up.
+
+[TP8] ``test_graph_replay_follows_metadata``: one CUDA graph of ``step_begin;
+front; K2(split)`` for a full and a sliding layer chained (and one of the
+same two layers' gated chain, the stock core's max length the table's: a
+sliding layer's trimmed table caps it at the window on the device, as a
+captured decode does), captured on the persistent buffers; between
+replays the host advances ``seq_lens``, positions, slots and the block tables
+as MRV2 does (crossing pages and the sliding window) and writes the first
+layer's boundary inputs anew; every replay equals an
+eager run of the same step on the same contents, 300 replays, health zero.

+)

+bf = torch.bfloat16
+f32 = torch.float32
+H, CORE, QKV = spec.HIDDEN, spec.CORE, spec.QKV_ROWS
+FULL, SLIDING = "full", "sliding"

+# the kernel layers of the fake model: layer 1 full (NoPE), layer 2 sliding

+MAX_BLOCKS = 2112  # a block table's row: 33,792 keys (> the 32,773 case)
+COS_CORE = 0.99999

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

+
+def gate64(attn, og) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The output norm and gate in fp64 (no rounding): per (token, head) row
+    of 64, ``a / sqrt(mean a^2 + eps) sigmoid(g)``. [S, HEADS, 64]."""
+    a = attn.double().reshape(attn.shape[0], spec.HEADS, spec.HEAD_DIM)
+    g = og.double().reshape(a.shape)
+    r = torch.rsqrt(a.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + spec.RMS_EPS)
+    return a * r * torch.sigmoid(g)
+
+
+def _fake_mrv2(device) -> ref.FakeMrv2:
+    """MRV2's persistent buffers of the two kernel layers: each its own KV
+    group, the sliding one's table nulled below the window."""
+    return ref.FakeMrv2(
+        {FULL: [NAME[FULL]], SLIDING: [NAME[SLIDING]]},
+        {SLIDING},
+        max_blocks=MAX_BLOCKS,
+        device=device,
+    )
+
+
+def _schedule(steps: int = REPLAYS) -> list[tuple[int, ...]]:
+    """The replay graph's per-step context lengths."""
+    return [tuple(L + i for L in REPLAY_START) for i in range(steps)]
+
+
+def _pages(lens, nblocks: int, seed: int) -> list[list[int]]:
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    return ref.assign_pages(lens, nblocks, generator=g)
+
+
+def _window_edges(kv: torch.Tensor, lens, pages) -> None:
+    """``EDGE_CASE``'s cache, in place: K scaled by 2^-4 (logits of std ~0.3
+    instead of ~5: a near-flat softmax) and the V of each request's oldest
+    window key (``max(L - WINDOW, 0)``) and of the key below it by 2^6, so a
+    core that drops the oldest key or reads one key too many moves the row by
+    O(1) on every seed, not only when that key happens to lead the softmax."""
+    kv[..., : spec.V_OFF] *= 2.0**-4
+    for L, row in zip(lens, pages):
+        lo = max(L - spec.WINDOW, 0)
+        for k in (lo - 1, lo):
+            if k >= 0:
+                kv[row[k // spec.KV_BLOCK], :, k % spec.KV_BLOCK, spec.V_OFF :] *= 64
+
+
+def _front_weights(rank: int, device) -> dict:
+    """One rank's K1 weights (the previous layer's FFN boundary, this layer's
+    pre-qkv norm, its qkv_proj shard [2304, 8192], the RoPE table):
+    replicated tensors from seed 17, the shard from 300 + rank."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.layers import (
+        MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection,
+    )
+
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(17)
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(300 + rank)
+
+    def rn(g, *shape, s=1.0, dtype=bf):
+        return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=device) * s).to(dtype)
+
+    conn = MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection(H).to(device)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        conn.gate.copy_(rn(gc, H, dtype=f32))
+    conn.materialize_coefficients()
+    return {
+        "w_postffn": rn(gc, H, s=0.1),
+        "ffn_alpha": conn.alpha.contiguous(),
+        "ffn_beta": conn.beta.contiguous(),
+        "w_preqkv": rn(gc, H, s=0.1),
+        "w_qkv": rn(gr, QKV, H, s=H**-0.5),
+        "cos_sin": ref.rope_table(MAX_POS, device=device),
+    }
+
+
+def _boundary_inputs(device, S: int, seed: int):
+    """(branch bf16, stream fp32) [S, H], replicated: the previous layer's
+    deferred boundary."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed)
+    branch = torch.randn(S, H, generator=g, device=device).to(bf)
+    stream = torch.randn(S, H, generator=g, device=device)
+    return branch, stream
+
+
+def _stock_front(fw, kind, branch, stream, positions, slots, kv):
+    """The stock front of a kernel layer: the deferred boundary, the qkv GEMM
+    (as served), the fused QK-norm / RoPE / KV insert in place. ->
+    (stream_out, qkvo)."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_rmsnorm import (
+        fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd,
+    )
+
+    attn_in, stream_out = fused_norm_residual_norm_fwd(
+        branch,
+        stream,
+        fw["w_postffn"],
+        fw["w_preqkv"],
+        spec.POST_FFN_EPS,
+        spec.RMS_EPS,
+        alpha=fw["ffn_alpha"],
+        beta=fw["ffn_beta"],
+        post_gain_center=spec.GAIN,
+        pre_gain_center=spec.GAIN,
+        post_input_scale=True,
+        out_dtype=bf,
+    )
+    qkvo = tn._gemm(attn_in, fw["w_qkv"])
+    rope = kind == SLIDING
+    ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(
+        qkvo,
+        positions,
+        spec.HEADS,
+        spec.KV_HEADS,
+        spec.HEAD_DIM,
+        spec.RMS_EPS,
+        fw["cos_sin"] if rope else None,
+        spec.HEAD_DIM if rope else 0,
+        slots,
+        kv,
+        spec.KV_BLOCK,
+    )
+    return stream_out, qkvo
+
+
+def _k1_front(runner, fw, kind, branch, stream, positions, slots, pad, kv):
+    """K1's front (Phase B1) with the runtime's arguments. -> (stream_out,
+    qkvo)."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import layers
+
+    S = branch.shape[0]
+    rope = kind == SLIDING
+    stream_out = torch.empty_like(stream)
+    qkvo = torch.empty(S, QKV, dtype=bf, device=stream.device)
+    layers.k1_launch(
+        spec.K1Build(tokens=S, rope=rope),
+        {
+            **{n: fw[n] for n in ("w_postffn", "ffn_alpha", "ffn_beta", "w_preqkv")},
+            "w_qkv": fw["w_qkv"],
+            "cos_sin": fw["cos_sin"] if rope else 0,
+            "max_pos": MAX_POS if rope else 0,
+            **layers.kv_args(kv),
+            "branch": branch,
+            "stream": stream,
+            "pad": pad,
+            "positions": positions,
+            "slots": slots,
+            "stream_out": stream_out,
+            "qkvo": qkvo,
+            "slot": spec.k1_slot(LAYER[kind]),
+            **runner.launch_args(),
+            "rank": runner.rank,
+        },
+    )
+    return stream_out, qkvo

+
+def _front(front, runner, fw, kind, branch, stream, step, kv):
+    name = NAME[kind]

+            kind,
+            branch,
+            stream,
+            step.positions,
+            step.slot_mapping[name],
+            step.pad,

+        )
+    return _stock_front(
+        fw, kind, branch, stream, step.positions, step.slot_mapping[name], kv
+    )
+
+
+def _stock_attention(qkvo, kv, md, kind, max_len=None):
+    """The stock core's attention output bf16 [S, CORE] (``paged_attention_v1``
+    as decode runs it, ``reference.stock_attention``); ``max_len``
+    defaults to the step's longest context (a graph passes the table's)."""
+    S = qkvo.shape[0]
+    lens = md.seq_lens.tolist() if max_len is None else [max_len]
+    ns = SimpleNamespace(
+        case=SimpleNamespace(S=S, window=kind == SLIDING, lens=tuple(lens)),
+        kv=kv,
+        bt=md.block_table,
+        seq_lens=md.seq_lens,
+        qkvo=qkvo,
+    )
+    return ref.stock_attention(ns).reshape(S, CORE)
+
+
+def _stock_gated(attn, qkvo):
+    """VLLM's gated core (o_proj's input) from the attention output."""
+    from vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.ops.kda import (
+        rms_norm_gated,
+    )
+
+    S = attn.shape[0]
+    return rms_norm_gated(
+        attn.view(S, spec.HEADS, 64),
+        qkvo[:, spec.ROW_G :].reshape(S, spec.HEADS, 64),
+        None,
+        None,
+        "sigmoid",
+        eps=spec.RMS_EPS,
+    ).reshape(S, CORE)
+
+
+def _split_args(qkvo, kv, md) -> dict:
+    """K2(split)'s core arguments as ``KernelLayer`` passes them."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import layers
+
+    bt = md.block_table
+    return {
+        "qkvo": qkvo,
+        **layers.kv_args(kv),
+        "block_table": bt,
+        "bt_rows": layers.table_rows(bt),
+        "bt_stride": bt.stride(0),
+        "seq_lens": md.seq_lens,
+    }
+
+
+def _k2(runner, w, key, core_args, stream, pad, kind):
+    """One K2 launch of build ``key`` (no epoch bump): (stream_out,
+    branch_out)."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layer
+
+    S = key.tokens
+    stream_out = torch.empty_like(stream)
+    branch_out = torch.empty(S, H, dtype=bf, device=stream.device)
+    layer.k2_launch(
+        key,
+        {
+            **{n: w[n] for n in tn.KERNEL_WEIGHTS},
+            **core_args,
+            "stream": stream,
+            "pad": pad,
+            "stream_out": stream_out,
+            "branch_out": branch_out,
+            "slot": spec.k2_slot(LAYER[kind]),
+            **runner.launch_args(),
+            **runner.peer_args(),
+        },
+    )
+    return stream_out, branch_out
+
+
+def _split_key(S: int, kind: str) -> spec.K2Build:
+    """The split build of width S and ``kind``."""
+    return spec.K2Build(tokens=S, core="split", window=kind == SLIDING)
+
+
+def _split_step(
+    front,
+    runner,
+    w,
+    fw,
+    kind,
+    branch,
+    stream,
+    step,
+    kv,
+    *,
+    begin=True,
+):
+    """``step_begin; front; K2(split)`` of one layer: (stream_out, branch_out,
+    qkvo)."""
+    S = branch.shape[0]
+    if begin:
+        runner.step_begin()
+    s1, qkvo = _front(front, runner, fw, kind, branch, stream, step, kv)
+    md = step.attn_metadata[NAME[kind]]
+    key = _split_key(S, kind)
+    out = _k2(runner, w, key, _split_args(qkvo, kv, md), s1, step.pad, kind)
+    return (*out, qkvo)
+
+
+def _gated_step(
+    front, runner, w, fw, kind, branch, stream, step, kv, max_len=None, *, begin=True
+):
+    """``step_begin; front; stock core; K2(gated)`` of one layer:
+    (stream_out, branch_out, qkvo, attn, front's stream_out)."""
+    S = branch.shape[0]
+    if begin:
+        runner.step_begin()
+    s1, qkvo = _front(front, runner, fw, kind, branch, stream, step, kv)
+    attn = _stock_attention(qkvo, kv, step.attn_metadata[NAME[kind]], kind, max_len)
+    key = spec.K2Build(tokens=S, core="gated")
+    out = _k2(runner, w, key, {"attn": attn, "qkvo": qkvo}, s1, step.pad, kind)
+    return (*out, qkvo, attn, s1)
+
+
+def _xo(runner, S: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The split core's gated rows (the combine's ``xo``) of the last launch."""
+    off, nbytes = spec.scratch_layout()[spec.XO]
+    return runner.scratch[off : off + nbytes].view(bf).view(-1, CORE)[:S].clone()
+
+
+def _bytes(kv: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return kv.view(torch.int16)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- [TP8]
+
+
+def _check_chain(runner, w, kind, case, gated, split, s_front, step, kvs):
+    """The 9.3 checks of one step (``gated``/``split``: the two runs'
+    outputs; ``kvs``: their caches)."""
+    lens, S = case
+    dev = s_front.device
+    sg, bg, qkvo_g, attn, _ = gated
+    ss, bs, qkvo_s, xo = split
+    pad = step.pad.cpu()
+    live = ~pad
+    lv = live.to(dev)
+    md = step.attn_metadata[NAME[kind]]
+    where = f"{kind} {lens} S={S}"
+    tn._assert_healthy(runner)

+    # picks (read back before any later launch; collective)
+    own = tnf._own_branch(runner, w, S)

+    # from the split core's own gated rows (diagnostic: stock's sensitivity)
+    stock_core = _stock_gated(attn.clone(), qkvo_g)

+    tn._stock_span(w, stock_core, s_front, step.pad, span, None)
+    span_xo: dict = {}
+    tn._stock_span(w, xo, s_front, step.pad, span_xo, None)

+    runner.step_begin()
+    tensor = spec.K2Build(tokens=S)
+    st, bt = _k2(runner, w, tensor, {"core": xo}, s_front, step.pad, kind)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    tn._assert_healthy(runner)
+    with tn._tp_checks(f"{where}: the split core"):
+        assert torch.equal(qkvo_s[lv], qkvo_g[lv]), "the front is not repeatable"
+        assert torch.equal(_bytes(kvs[0]), _bytes(kvs[1])), "the KV cache differs"
+        # the gated rows: vs vLLM's gated core on the stock attention, and
+        # never further from the fp64 gated attention than stock (E9)
+        q = qkvo_g[:, :CORE].reshape(S, spec.HEADS, 64)
+        a64 = ref.gqa_decode(
+            q, kvs[1], md.block_table, md.seq_lens, window=kind == SLIDING, pad=pad
+        )
+        g64 = gate64(a64, qkvo_g[:, spec.ROW_G :].cpu())[live.cpu()]
+        got = xo.cpu().reshape(S, spec.HEADS, 64)[live]
+        stock = stock_core.cpu().reshape(S, spec.HEADS, 64)[live]
+        assert ref.cos(got, stock) > COS_CORE, (where, ref.cos(got, stock))
+        e_got = (got.double() - g64).abs().max().item()
+        e_stock = (stock.double() - g64).abs().max().item()
+        ulp = 2.0 ** (math.floor(math.log2(g64.abs().max().item())) - 7)
+        assert e_got <= e_stock + 2 * ulp, (where, e_got, e_stock)
+        u = ref.row_ulps(got, stock)
+        print(
+            f"{where}: xo vs stock gate: max {u.max().item():.2f} row ulps, "
+            f"<= 1 on {(u <= 1).float().mean().item():.5f}; fp64 err "
+            f"{e_got:.3g} (stock {e_stock:.3g})",
+            flush=True,
+        )
+        assert (xo[pad.to(xo.device)].float() == 0).all()
+        # the layer's outputs. stream_out: vs the K2(gated) step and the stock
+        # span. The tail after the core is Phase A's: bit for bit K2(tensor)
+        # on the split core's own gated rows. branch_out: vs vLLM's experts on
+        # its own ffn_in rows and picks (Phase A's reference, DESIGN_BC 9.3),
+        # not vs the gated / stock chain: two cores that differ by an ulp on
+        # ~40 % of the rows' elements (split vs paged_attention_v1, both held
+        # above) take the stock span itself to branch cos 0.973 .. 0.995
+        # (``stock span`` printed)
+        assert ref.cos(ss[lv], sg[lv]) > tn.COS_STAGE, where
+        assert ref.cos(ss[lv], span["stream"][lv]) > tn.COS_STAGE, where
+        assert torch.equal(st, ss) and torch.equal(bt, bs), (where, "K2(tensor)")
+        assert ref.cos(bs[lv], own[lv]) > tn.COS_CHAIN, where
+        assert (ss[~lv] == 0).all() and (bs[~lv].float() == 0).all(), where
+        sb = span["branch"][lv]
+        print(
+            f"{where}: branch cos vs own experts {ref.cos(bs[lv], own[lv]):.7f}; "
+            f"whole chain vs K2(gated) {ref.cos(bs[lv], bg[lv]):.5f}, vs stock "
+            f"span {ref.cos(bs[lv], span['branch'][lv]):.5f}; stock span on "
+            f"xo vs on stock's core {ref.cos(span_xo['branch'][lv], sb):.5f}",
+            flush=True,
+        )
+    tn._all_ranks_equal(ss, f"stream_out ({where})")
+    tn._all_ranks_equal(bs, f"branch_out ({where})")
+

+def _chain(
+    front,
+    monkeypatch,
+    tp_size,
+    pp_size,
+    rank,
+    distributed_init_port,
+):
+    device = tn._init_worker(monkeypatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)

+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.runner import MonoRunner

+    fw = _front_weights(rank, device)
+    mrv2 = _fake_mrv2(device)

+        nblocks = need + 64

+                fw,
