+"""K2(split) phase 1, Phase C (DESIGN_BC 7): the split half of an in-kernel
+split-KV GQA decode core for the q = 1 widths, and the core load that reads
+the combine's gated rows.
+
+    split       one unit a CTA: unit u = (t 2 + kvh) N + p (N =
+                ``K2Build.nsplit()``) attends token t's 8 q heads of
+                KV head kvh over part p of its pages, flash-decoding style ->
+                its unnormalized partial ``opart`` and (max, sum) ``pstat``
+                (fp32, device scope), then the ``srdy`` flag of u
+    load_core   every CTA: the 16 S ``crdy`` flags (the combine's, one a
+                (token, q head)), then the gated rows ``xo`` -> LDS ``xl``
+                (back's padded rows), a pad row as zeros
+
+Keys, from the layer's KV group (``block_table``, ``seq_lens``) and kind
+(``K2Build.window``), all in-kernel: L = ``seq_lens[t]`` clamped to the
+table's row (0 on a pad row), keys lo <= k < L with lo = L - WINDOW on a
+sliding layer (else 0); pages b0 = lo // 16 .. (L - 1) // 16, nb of them, cut
+into N parts of ``per = max(cdiv(nb, N), MIN_PER)`` pages: the combine's own
+``unit_plan``, so a unit holds keys iff the combine waits
+for it (p < live).
+Pages outside [b0, b0 + nb) are never read: a sliding group's table nulls only
+entries below b0 (DESIGN_BC 1.5). A page is one (block, KV head) of the cache
+``kv`` [blocks, 2, 16, 128] bf16 at byte strides ``kv_sb, kv_sh, kv_st``: its
+base is 64-bit (a layer's cache passes 4 GiB), a buffer resource of 16 rows.
+
+Within a unit wave w takes pages w, w + 8, ... (``uniform``: the loop count is
+wave-uniform), two in flight (the next page's K and V issued before this one's
+math), the block ids lane-parallel, 64 a load. Per page (lane (j, g) = (lane %
+16, lane // 16); MFMA maps as DESIGN_BC 7.3):
+
+    QK   2 x mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16, A = the page's 16 keys (lane: key j, dims
+         16 g ..), B = q (column j = q head 8 kvh + j, zero for j >= 8),
+         contraction s element 8 g + e <-> dim 16 g + 8 s + e on both sides
+         -> lane (j, g) holds head j's scores of keys 4 g + e
+    soft base 2, ``s = qk QK_SCALE_LOG2E``, a masked key NEG (select, never a
+         multiply); m, alpha per head (xshfl 16, 32); P = bf16(exp2(s - m)),
+         ``l`` the sum of the bf16 P the MFMA consumes (E9)
+    PV   4 x mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k, B = P as the lane holds it (no LDS),
+         A = V^T, the masked keys' V words zeroed (NaN-safe: 0 x NaN is NaN)
+         -> lane (j, g): head j's dims 16 g + 4 e + dt
+
+The 8 waves merge in LDS (``lds_struct``) in wave order; thread (j, d) = (tid
+// 64, tid % 64) stores its head's dim d. An empty unit or wave carries m =
+NEG, l = 0, o = 0. Plain regions read in this launch are stored ``CM_DEV``
+(rule 9), and the flag is published after them (``publish``).
+
+Order (rule 8, DESIGN_BC 7.2): ``stage_split`` polls nothing and holds no
+o_proj weights; its first loads are the pad word, ``seq_lens[t]`` and q.
+``load_core`` polls ``crdy`` with only the CTA's own o_proj weights in flight
+(their stage needs them next).
+"""
+
+import functools
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.attention.combine import (
+    unit_plan,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    bf16_round,
+    hw_exp2,
+    ld_dev,
+    ld_i32,
+    ld_pad,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    readlane,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    xshfl,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+    sel,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (
+    publish,
+    uniform_addr,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    CORE,
+    HEAD_DIM,
+    HEADS,
+    KV_BLOCK,
+    KV_HEADS,
+    OPART,
+    PSTAT,
+    Q_PER_KV,
+    QK_SCALE_LOG2E,
+    QKV_ROWS,
+    V_OFF,
+    XO,
+    K2Build,
+    crdy_pair,
+    opart_word,
+    pstat_word,
+    srdy_pair,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import gemv
+
+STAGE = "split"
+
+NEG = -3.4028234663852886e38  # finite: NEG - NEG = 0, never inf - inf
+BID_LANES = 64  # block ids a wave loads at once (a lane each)
+XL_ROW = CORE + gemv.LDS_PAD  # bf16 a padded LDS core row (back.XL_ROW)
+OKW = CORE // 8  # dwordx4 a core row
+V_BYTES = 2 * V_OFF  # V's byte offset in the row
+LANE_HEADS = 16  # MFMA columns: q heads j < Q_PER_KV, the rest zero
+assert HEADS == KV_HEADS * Q_PER_KV and Q_PER_KV == WAVES and HEAD_DIM == 64
+assert KV_BLOCK == 16  # a page is one MFMA M: 16 keys
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def lds_struct(s: int):
+    """The split's LDS: each wave's per-head max ``ms`` and sum ``ls`` (16
+    columns, heads 0 .. 7 used) and its 8 heads' 64-dim rows ``os``, fp32:
+    17,408 B, the same at every width (``s`` keys the stage union only).
+    Cached: one struct type a width."""
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class SplitLds:
+        ms: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * LANE_HEADS, 16]
+        ls: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * LANE_HEADS, 16]
+        os: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * Q_PER_KV * HEAD_DIM, 16]
+
+    return SplitLds
+
+
+def key_of(c) -> K2Build:
+    """The build's key, a K2Build(core="split") (its window, N and MIN_PER
+    are static)."""
+    key = c.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, K2Build) or key.core != "split":
+        raise ValueError(f"the split core needs a K2Build(core='split') key: {key!r}")
+    return key
+
+
+def entry_loads(c, t, kvh) -> dict:
+    """The unit's first loads, raw (anything computed from them here would
+    wait for them before the rest are issued): row t's pad word and sequence
+    length, then this lane's q operand (``_q_loads``)."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    return {
+        "pad": ld_i32(a["pad"], t // 4),
+        "n": ld_i32(a["seq_lens"], t),
+        "q": _q_loads(c, t, kvh),
+    }
+
+
+def row_len(c, t, pre):
+    """Row t's context length L from ``entry_loads``' words (wave-uniform): 0
+    on a pad row, else ``seq_lens[t]`` clamped to [0, the table's row of
+    ``bt_stride`` pages)."""
+    pad_t = ((uniform(pre["pad"]) >> (8 * (t % 4))) & 0xFF) != 0
+    cap = fx.Int32(c["args"]["bt_stride"]) * KV_BLOCK
+    L = fx.max(fx.min(uniform(pre["n"]), cap), 0)
+    return pad_t.select(fx.Int32(0), L)
+
+
+def pages(L, window: bool, n: int, p):
+    """Part p of N = ``n`` at context length L: (lo, pa, pe), keys lo <= k <
+    L, pages [pa, pe), empty when pe <= pa (p >= the combine's live). The
+    combine's ``unit_plan``; Python ints or traced Int32."""
+    lo, b0, nb, per, _ = unit_plan(L, window, n)
+    pa = b0 + p * per
+    pe = sel(pa + per < b0 + nb, pa + per, b0 + nb)
+    return lo, pa, pe
+
+
+def _q_loads(c, t, kvh):
+    """This lane's q operand, two dwordx4 (MFMA s = 0, 1): head 8 kvh + j,
+    dims 16 g + 8 s .. + 8 of qkvo row t (a lane j >= 8 loads head 8 kvh + 7;
+    ``stage_split`` zeroes it). Raw: the CTA's entry loads."""
+    lane = c["lane"]
+    j = fx.min(lane % LANE_HEADS, Q_PER_KV - 1)
+    g = lane // LANE_HEADS
+    col = HEAD_DIM * (Q_PER_KV * kvh + j) + 16 * g
+    r_q = rsrc(c["args"]["qkvo"])
+    return [
+        fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                r_q, (t * QKV_ROWS + col + 8 * s) // 2, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32
+            )
+        )
+        for s in range(2)
+    ]
+
+
+def _bid_chunk(c, t, first, stop, wave, k):
+    """Chunk k of a wave's block ids: lane i holds the table entry of page
+    first + wave + 8 (64 k + i) of row t, or 0 past ``stop`` (a masked load:
+    the resource is sized by the table's buffer, ``bt_rows`` rows)."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    stride = fx.Int32(a["bt_stride"])
+    nbytes = fx.Int64(fx.Int32(a["bt_rows"])) * fx.Int64(stride) * 4
+    r_bt = rsrc(a["block_table"], fx.min(nbytes, fx.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF)))
+    pg = first + wave + WAVES * (BID_LANES * k + c["lane"])
+    ok = pg < stop
+    return fx.Int32(
+        bo.buffer_load(
+            r_bt,
+            t * stride + fx.min(pg, fx.max(stop - 1, 0)),
+            vec_width=1,
+            dtype=T.i32,
+            mask=ok,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _page_loads(c, kvh, blk):
+    """Page ``blk``'s (KV head kvh) operands of this lane: K of key lane % 16,
+    dims 16 g .. + 16 (2 dwordx4, the QK A operands), and V of keys 4 g + e,
+    dims 4 (lane % 16) .. + 4 (4 dwordx2, e = 0 .. 3). The page's base is
+    64-bit and wave-uniform; the offsets are 32-bit within its 16 rows."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    lane = c["lane"]
+    r16 = lane % 16
+    g = lane // 16
+    st = fx.Int32(a["kv_st"])
+    page = (
+        a["kv"]
+        + fx.Int64(blk) * fx.Int64(a["kv_sb"])
+        + fx.Int64(kvh) * fx.Int64(a["kv_sh"])
+    )
+    rp = rsrc(page, st * KV_BLOCK)
+    kk = [
+        fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rp, (r16 * st + 32 * g + 16 * s) // 4, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32
+            )
+        )
+        for s in range(2)
+    ]
+    vv = [
+        fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rp,
+                ((4 * g + e) * st + V_BYTES + 8 * r16) // 4,
+                vec_width=2,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+            )
+        )
+        for e in range(4)
+    ]
+    return kk + vv
+
+
+def _v_operand(vv, dt):
+    """The PV A operand of MFMA dt: V^T row i (lane % 16) = dim 4 i + dt, keys
+    4 g + e (e = 0 .. 3): bf16 dt of each key's 4 dims, as i16 x 4."""
+    lo = dt % 2 == 0
+    w = [vv[e][dt // 2] for e in range(4)]
+    if lo:
+        pk = [(w[2 * h] & 0xFFFF) | (w[2 * h + 1] << 16) for h in range(2)]
+    else:
+        pk = [
+            ((w[2 * h] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) | (w[2 * h + 1] & fx.Int32(-65536))
+            for h in range(2)
+        ]
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(pk, fx.Int32).bitcast(fx.Int16)
+
+
+def _scale(v, al):
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements([v[i] * al for i in range(4)], fx.Float32)
+
+
+def _attend(c, ops, qa, i, base, lo, L, live, m, den, acc):
+    """Page i of the wave's (page ``base + 8 i``; ``ops``: its
+    ``_page_loads``) into this lane's running max ``m``, sum ``den`` (7.3's
+    l) and ``acc`` of head j: QK, the masked base-2 scores, the rescale, PV.
+    ``live``: whether the page is the wave's (False: every key masked, the
+    state unchanged). -> (m, den, acc)."""
+    g = c["lane"] // LANE_HEADS
+    zero4 = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    # keys 16 pg + 4 g + e of this lane: in [lo, L)?
+    kb = KV_BLOCK * (base + WAVES * i) + 4 * g
+    ok = [live & (kb + e >= lo) & (kb + e < L) for e in range(4)]
+    sc = mfma_bf16(ops[0].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), qa[0], zero4)
+    sc = mfma_bf16(ops[1].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), qa[1], sc)
+    sv = [
+        fx.Float32(ok[e].select(sc[e] * fx.Float32(QK_SCALE_LOG2E), fx.Float32(NEG)))
+        for e in range(4)
+    ]
+    mt = fx.max(fx.max(sv[0], sv[1]), fx.max(sv[2], sv[3]))
+    mt = fx.max(mt, xshfl(mt, 16))
+    mt = fx.max(mt, xshfl(mt, 32))
+    mn = fx.max(m, mt)
+    al = hw_exp2(m - mn)
+    pr = [
+        bf16_round(ok[e].select(hw_exp2(sv[e] - mn), fx.Float32(0.0))) for e in range(4)
+    ]
+    ln = den * al + ((pr[0] + pr[1]) + (pr[2] + pr[3]))
+    pb = fx.Vector.from_elements(pr, fx.Float32).to(fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int16)
+    # a masked key's V words zeroed in the operand (key 4 g + e: ok[e])
+    vv = [
+        fx.Vector.from_elements(
+            [ok[e].select(ops[2 + e][h], fx.Int32(0)) for h in range(2)], fx.Int32
+        )
+        for e in range(4)
+    ]
+    accn = [
+        fx.Vector(
+            rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k(
+                T.vec(4, T.f32), [_v_operand(vv, dt), pb, _scale(acc[dt], al)]
+            )
+        )
+        for dt in range(4)
+    ]
+    return mn, ln, accn
+
+
+def _block(bid, i, kv_last):
+    """Page i's block id from the wave's id chunk, clamped into the cache."""
+    return fx.max(fx.min(readlane(bid, i % BID_LANES), kv_last), 0)
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_split(c, u):
+    """Split unit ``u`` (this CTA's: u < ``spec.n_units``) -> ``opart`` rows u
+    8 .., ``pstat`` (m, l) of its 8 q heads, then ``srdy[u]``. Polls nothing;
+    ends with ``publish``'s barrier (the LDS hand-over)."""
+    tid, lane = c["tid"], c["lane"]
+    a, scr = c["args"], c["scr"]
+    sl = c["lds"]["split"]
+    key = key_of(c)
+    window, n = key.window, key.nsplit()
+    u = fx.Int32(u)
+    t = u // (2 * n)
+    kvh = (u // n) % KV_HEADS
+    p = u % n
+    wave = uniform(c["wave"])  # the page loop's count is wave-uniform
+    j = lane % LANE_HEADS
+    g = lane // LANE_HEADS
+    # FIRST: the pad word, the length and q, all in flight before any wait
+    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+    pre = entry_loads(c, t, kvh)
+    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+    L = row_len(c, t, pre)
+    lo, pa, pe = pages(L, window, n, p)
+    nw = (fx.max(pe - pa - wave, 0) + (WAVES - 1)) // WAVES  # this wave's pages
+    base = pa + wave
+    bid = _bid_chunk(c, t, pa, pe, wave, 0)
+    kv_last = fx.Int32(a["kv_blocks"]) - 1
+    live_q = j < Q_PER_KV
+    qa = [
+        fx.Vector.from_elements(
+            [live_q.select(q[i], fx.Int32(0)) for i in range(4)], fx.Int32
+        ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+        for q in pre["q"]
+    ]
+    zero4 = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    m = fx.Float32(NEG)
+    den = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    acc = [zero4, zero4, zero4, zero4]
+    # pages two at a time, two in flight: page i + 1's loads go out before
+    # page i's math, page i + 2's before page i + 1's. Unrolled, so the one
+    # buffer the back-edge carries (``ca``, page i + 2) keeps its registers
+    # (a rotated pair cur = fol is copied there, which waits for the loads).
+    # A page past the wave's last reloads the last one (in bounds, unused).
+    ca = _page_loads(c, kvh, _block(bid, 0, kv_last))
+    i = fx.Int32(0)
+    while i < nw:
+        i1 = i + 1
+        i2 = i + 2
+        cb = _page_loads(c, kvh, _block(bid, fx.min(i1, nw - 1), kv_last))
+        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+        m, den, acc = _attend(c, ca, qa, i, base, lo, L, i < nw, m, den, acc)
+        # i is even: pages i, i + 1 share a chunk of ids; i + 2 may start one.
+        # The id is read in both branches: only a reload waits for its load
+        # (a read after the join would wait there on every path, draining
+        # page i + 1's loads). (Defined first: the branches yield it.)
+        blk2 = fx.Int32(0)
+        if (i2 % BID_LANES == 0) & (i2 < nw):
+            bid = _bid_chunk(c, t, pa, pe, wave, i2 // BID_LANES)
+            blk2 = _block(bid, i2, kv_last)
+        else:
+            blk2 = _block(bid, fx.min(i2, nw - 1), kv_last)
+        ca = _page_loads(c, kvh, blk2)
+        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+        m, den, acc = _attend(c, cb, qa, i1, base, lo, L, i1 < nw, m, den, acc)
+        i = i2
+    den = den + xshfl(den, 16)
+    den = den + xshfl(den, 32)
+    # the waves' (m, l, o) -> LDS: lanes g == 0 the per-head m and l, lanes
+    # j < 8 their head's dims 16 g .. + 16 (4 x 16 B)
+    if g == 0:
+        fx.ptr_store(m, sl["ms"] + (c["wave"] * LANE_HEADS + j))
+        fx.ptr_store(den, sl["ls"] + (c["wave"] * LANE_HEADS + j))
+    if live_q:
+        row = sl["os"] + ((c["wave"] * Q_PER_KV + j) * HEAD_DIM + 16 * g)
+        for e in range_constexpr(4):
+            fx.ptr_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements([acc[dt][e] for dt in range(4)], fx.Float32),
+                row + 4 * e,
+            )
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # thread (head jj, dim d): the 8 waves in wave order
+    jj = tid // HEAD_DIM
+    d = tid % HEAD_DIM
+    mw = [fx.ptr_load(sl["ms"] + (w * LANE_HEADS + jj)) for w in range(WAVES)]
+    big = mw[0]
+    for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
+        big = fx.max(big, mw[w])
+    lsum = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    osum = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+        wt = hw_exp2(mw[w] - big)
+        lsum = lsum + fx.ptr_load(sl["ls"] + (w * LANE_HEADS + jj)) * wt
+        osum = osum + fx.ptr_load(sl["os"] + ((w * Q_PER_KV + jj) * HEAD_DIM + d)) * wt
+    bo.buffer_store(osum, rsrc(scr[OPART]), opart_word(u, jj, d), cache_modifier=CM_DEV)
+    if d == 0:
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([big, lsum], fx.Float32),
+            rsrc(scr[PSTAT]),
+            pstat_word(u, jj, 0),
+            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+        )
+    publish(c["put"], scr["srdy"], srdy_pair(u), 1, tid == 0)
+
+
+@traced
+def load_core(c):
+    """The combine's gated rows -> LDS ``xl`` (back's padded rows), after
+    every (token, q head)'s ``crdy``: thread tid < 16 S polls pair tid (a
+    fresh wave-uniform base: a combine CTA has just put to the region), then
+    S x 128 dwordx4 at device scope; a pad row as zeros (``select``). Ends
+    with the hand-over barrier."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    xl = c["lds"]["back"]["xl"]
+    if tid < HEADS * s:
+        crdy = uniform_addr(c["scr"]["crdy"])
+        c["poll"]([(crdy, crdy_pair(tid // HEADS, tid % HEADS), 1)])
+    gpu.barrier()
+    words = s * OKW
+    for r in range_constexpr((words + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * r, words - 1)
+        v = fx.Vector(ld_dev(c["scr"][XO], e * 4, 4))
+        t = e // OKW
+        k = e % OKW * 8
+        dead = ld_pad(a["pad"], t)
+        v = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+            [dead.select(fx.Int32(0), v[q]) for q in range(4)], fx.Int32
+        )
+        if tid + THREADS * r < words:
+            fx.ptr_store(v, xl + (t * XL_ROW + k) // 2)
+    gpu.barrier()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The stage context every K2 and K1 stage takes (``c``), built once at the
+top of a kernel by ``make_context``.
+
+The context (built in the kernel's trace; every value below is traced unless
+noted):
+
+    S                     launch rows (a Python int, a build constant)
+    tid, bid, lane, wave  thread, CTA, tid % 64, tid // 64
+    rank, slot            ABI scalars
+    has_peers             ``make_context``'s ``peers``
+    red                   LDS f32[WAVES 64 4]: MFMA accumulators (``row_sum``)
+    rt                    ``RouteLds`` field -> LDS pointer ({} without it)
+    lds                   stage -> field -> LDS pointer (the stage union)
+    args                  ABI name -> kernel argument (Int64 address / Int32)
+    scr                   scratch mailbox region -> ``Addr`` (Phases A, B and
+                          C: ``spec.SCRATCH_REGIONS_ALL``); the plain regions
+                          (``xrow``, ``spec.SCRATCH_PLAIN_BC``): Int64 bases
+
+and, from ``settle`` on (the launch's scalar words: a kernel loads them once
+its first loads are issued, so their wait never lands ahead of those):
+
+    e, par                the step epoch (22 bits) and its parity
+    put, put_bf,          the launch's ``Mailbox`` methods (bound: the AST
+    put_words, poll       rewriter must see no method call on a local)
+    peer                  peer region -> [an ``Addr`` a rank], and
+                          region + "_own" -> this rank's, parity-shifted ({}
+                          without peers)
+
+A rank-local kernel (K1) builds its context with ``peers=False`` (no
+``peers`` argument, no peer regions) and ``route_lds=False`` (no route table
+in its LDS).
+
+LDS: the fixed ``red`` and ``RouteLds`` (if any), then one union of the
+stages' structs (``lds_structs``: stage -> ``fx.struct``, or stage ->
+{member: ``fx.struct``} for a sequential composite whose members are all live
+at once, e.g. K2's ``xq_ug``). A composite's fields are reachable both under
+its own name and under each member's. Union members share bytes: a stage that
+touches its struct or ``red`` ends with ``gpu.barrier()`` (the hand-over rule).
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from flydsl.compiler.protocol import dsl_align_of, dsl_size_of
+from flydsl.expr.struct import is_struct_type
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono import spec
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.debug import (
+    region_ids,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    ld_s32,
+    pin_s,
+    ptr64,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    LDS_BYTES,
+    WAVES,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ranks import (
+    peer_bases,
+    peer_words,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.route_lds import (
+    RouteLds,
+    route_ptrs,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (
+    Mailbox,
+    load_budget,
+    load_epoch,
+    preg,
+    shift,
+    sreg,
+    stall,
+    step_epoch,
+    step_tag,
+    wait_budget,
+)
+
+RED_WORDS = WAVES * 64 * 4  # a wave's 16x16 accumulator, 4 f32 a lane
+
+
+@fx.struct
+class FixedLds:
+    red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, RED_WORDS, 16]
+
+
+# The arguments make_context reads; a kernel's ``args`` carries them and any
+# other K2 argument its stages use. Without peers (K1), all but ``peers``.
+CONTEXT_ARGS = ("scratch", "peers", "rank", "epoch", "slot", "health", "alarm")
+LOCAL_CONTEXT_ARGS = tuple(n for n in CONTEXT_ARGS if n != "peers")
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- LDS
+
+
+def _member(stage: str, st):
+    """A union member: a stage's struct, or its members laid out in order."""
+    if isinstance(st, Mapping):
+        if not st:
+            raise ValueError(f"LDS composite {stage!r} has no member")
+        for name, t in st.items():
+            if not is_struct_type(t):
+                raise TypeError(f"LDS {stage}.{name} is not an fx.struct: {t!r}")
+        return fx.struct[tuple(slice(name, t) for name, t in st.items())]
+    if not is_struct_type(st):
+        raise TypeError(f"LDS {stage!r} is not an fx.struct: {st!r}")
+    return st
+
+
+def stage_union(lds_structs: Mapping | None):
+    """The union of the stages' LDS structs (None when there is none)."""
+    if not lds_structs:
+        return None
+    return fx.union[
+        tuple(slice(stage, _member(stage, st)) for stage, st in lds_structs.items())
+    ]
+
+
+def _align_up(n: int, a: int) -> int:
+    return (n + a - 1) // a * a
+
+
+def lds_total_bytes(lds_structs: Mapping | None = None, route_lds: bool = True) -> int:
+    """The LDS a context with ``lds_structs`` allocates: ``red``, ``RouteLds``
+    (with ``route_lds``), then the stage union, each at its alignment
+    (``SharedAllocator``'s bump)."""
+    off = 0
+    parts = [FixedLds, RouteLds] if route_lds else [FixedLds]
+    union = stage_union(lds_structs)
+    if union is not None:
+        parts.append(union)
+    for t in parts:
+        off = _align_up(off, dsl_align_of(t)) + dsl_size_of(t)
+    return off
+
+
+def _field_ptrs(inst, t, out: dict, where: str) -> dict:
+    """Field -> LDS pointer of a peeked struct ``inst`` of type ``t``, nested
+    structs flattened (field names must be unique)."""
+    for f in t.__dsl_field_defs__:
+        v = getattr(inst, f.name)
+        if is_struct_type(f.type_spec):
+            _field_ptrs(v, f.type_spec, out, f"{where}.{f.name}")
+            continue
+        if f.name in out:
+            raise ValueError(f"LDS field {f.name!r} appears twice in {where}")
+        out[f.name] = v.ptr
+    return out
+
+
+def _stage_ptrs(alloc, lds_structs: Mapping | None) -> dict:
+    """Allocate the stage union; stage (and composite member) -> field ->
+    pointer."""
+    lds: dict = {}
+    union = stage_union(lds_structs)
+    if union is None or lds_structs is None:
+        return lds
+    st = alloc.allocate(union)
+    for stage, member in lds_structs.items():
+        inst = getattr(st, stage).peek()
+        if isinstance(member, Mapping):
+            flat: dict = {}
+            for name, t in member.items():
+                if name in lds or name in lds_structs:
+                    raise ValueError(f"LDS name {name!r} names two stages")
+                lds[name] = _field_ptrs(getattr(inst, name), t, {}, f"{stage}.{name}")
+                for k, p in lds[name].items():
+                    if k in flat:
+                        raise ValueError(f"LDS field {k!r} appears twice in {stage}")
+                    flat[k] = p
+            lds[stage] = flat
+        else:
+            if stage in lds:
+                raise ValueError(f"LDS name {stage!r} names two stages")
+            lds[stage] = _field_ptrs(inst, member, {}, stage)
+    return lds
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the context
+
+
+def _peer_regions(words, par) -> dict:
+    """Peer region -> [an ``Addr`` a rank] and region + "_own" -> this rank's,
+    in the epoch parity ``par``'s half. ``words``: the peer table's, then this
+    rank's entry (``settle``)."""
+    bases = peer_bases(words[:-2])
+    own = ptr64(words[-2], words[-1])
+    delta = fx.Int64(par) * spec.peer_half_bytes()
+    peer: dict = {}
+    for region, (off, _) in spec.peer_layout().items():
+        peer[region] = [shift(preg(b, off, region), delta) for b in bases]
+        peer[region + "_own"] = shift(preg(own, off, region), delta)
+    return peer
+
+
+def make_context(
+    S: int,
+    args: Mapping,
+    lds_structs: Mapping | None = None,
+    *,
+    key: spec.K2Build | spec.K1Build | None = None,
+    peers: bool = True,
+    route_lds: bool = True,
+) -> dict:
+    """The stage context ``c`` (module docstring), traced in a kernel body.
+
+    ``args``: ABI name -> kernel argument, at least ``CONTEXT_ARGS``
+    (``LOCAL_CONTEXT_ARGS`` without ``peers``).
+    ``lds_structs``: stage -> struct (or {member: struct}), the stage union.
+    ``key``: a K2 or K1 build; a K2 fault build compiles ``sync.stall`` in first
+    (its prologue).
+    ``peers``: ``settle`` builds the peer regions from the ``peers`` argument
+    (False: a rank-local kernel, no ``peers`` argument read and ``peer``
+    empty).
+    ``route_lds``: allocate ``RouteLds`` (False: ``rt`` empty).
+    """
+    if not 1 <= S <= spec.MAX_ROWS:
+        raise ValueError(f"launch rows {S} (1 .. {spec.MAX_ROWS})")
+    needs = CONTEXT_ARGS if peers else LOCAL_CONTEXT_ARGS
+    missing = [n for n in needs if n not in args]
+    if missing:
+        raise KeyError(f"make_context needs the arguments {missing}")
+    lds_bytes = lds_total_bytes(lds_structs, route_lds)
+    if lds_bytes > LDS_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError(f"{lds_bytes} B of LDS > {LDS_BYTES} (a CU's)")
+    scratch, rank = args["scratch"], args["rank"]
+    epoch, slot = args["epoch"], args["slot"]
+    tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+    bid = fx.block_idx.x
+    alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+    fixed = alloc.allocate(FixedLds).peek()
+    rl = alloc.allocate(RouteLds).peek() if route_lds else None
+    lds = _stage_ptrs(alloc, lds_structs)
+    if isinstance(key, spec.K2Build) and key.faulty:
+        stall(
+            key.fault_rank,
+            key.fault_epoch,
+            key.fault_slot,
+            key.fault_ticks,
+            rank,
+            epoch,
+            slot,
+        )
+    lay = spec.scratch_layout()
+    scr: dict = {r: sreg(scratch, lay[r][0], r) for r in spec.SCRATCH_REGIONS}
+    scr[spec.XROW] = scratch + fx.Int64(lay[spec.XROW][0])
+    # Phases B and C, laid out past xrow (Phase A's offsets stay)
+    for r in spec.SCRATCH_REGIONS_BC:
+        scr[r] = sreg(scratch, lay[r][0], r)
+    for name, _, _ in spec.SCRATCH_PLAIN_BC:
+        if name is not None:  # None: a reserved gap
+            scr[name] = scratch + fx.Int64(lay[name][0])
+    return {
+        "S": S,
+        "tid": tid,
+        "bid": bid,
+        "lane": tid % 64,
+        "wave": tid // 64,
+        "rank": rank,
+        "slot": slot,
+        "has_peers": peers,
+        "red": fixed.red.ptr,
+        "rt": route_ptrs(rl) if rl is not None else {},
+        "lds": lds,
+        "args": dict(args),
+        "scr": scr,
+        "key": key,
+    }
+
+
+def settle(c) -> None:
+    """Loads the launch's scalar words (``ld_s32``: the epoch, the
+    ``WAIT_BUDGET`` word, the peer table and this rank's entry), pins them
+    (``pin_s``) and adds to ``c`` what is built from them: ``e``, ``par``, the
+    ``Mailbox`` methods and ``peer``. A kernel calls it right after its first
+    loads are issued, at top level or once in each CTA-uniform branch that
+    publishes or polls: the words' round trip (an lgkmcnt wait, never a vmcnt
+    one) then overlaps those loads (unpinned, a scalar load sinks to its first
+    use, a poll's, and exposes its round trip there). A stage that publishes
+    or polls before it fails at trace (no ``put`` / ``poll``)."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    # this rank's entry (the one load at a traced offset) issued first: last,
+    # LLVM put it behind a first lgkmcnt wait, a second round trip
+    own = []
+    if c["has_peers"]:
+        own = [ld_s32(a["peers"], 2 * c["rank"] + h) for h in range(2)]
+    words = own + [load_epoch(a["epoch"]), load_budget(a["health"])]
+    if c["has_peers"]:
+        words += peer_words(a["peers"], spec.TP)
+    w = pin_s(words)
+    w = w[len(own) :] + w[: len(own)]  # epoch, budget, table, this rank's
+    e = step_epoch(w[0])
+    mb = Mailbox(
+        step_tag(e, c["slot"]) - 1,
+        a["health"],
+        a["alarm"],
+        region_ids(spec.REGIONS),
+        wait_budget(w[1]),
+    )
+    par = e & 1
+    c["e"] = e
+    c["par"] = par
+    c["put"] = mb.put
+    c["put_bf"] = mb.put_bf
+    c["put_words"] = mb.put_words
+    c["poll"] = mb.poll
+    c["peer"] = _peer_regions(w[2:], par) if len(w) > 2 else {}

+"""Wait records: which mailbox region a CTA's given-up wait was on."""
+
+import zlib
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import RECORD_WORDS
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import BLOCKS
+
+
+def region_id(name: str) -> int:
+    """A mailbox region's id in a wait record: its name's CRC-32 (31 bits), the
+    same in every kernel and table that names it."""
+    return zlib.crc32(name.encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF
+
+
+def region_ids(names) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Name -> ``region_id``: a ``Mailbox``'s table."""
+    return {n: region_id(n) for n in names}
+
+
+def given_up_waits(health: torch.Tensor, names) -> list[str]:
+    """Each CTA's first wait that gave up, the earliest first, from a rank's
+    ``health`` words; ``names`` the regions a record may name."""
+    by_id = {region_id(n): n for n in names}
+    records = health.view(BLOCKS + 1, RECORD_WORDS)[1:]
+    records = records[records[:, 0] != 0].tolist()
+    t0 = min((r[6] for r in records), default=0)
+    return [
+        f"+{(at - t0) / 100:.0f} us CTA {cta}: {by_id.get(rid, rid)} pair {idx}"
+        f" waited for tag {tag}, saw {seen}"
+        for _, rid, idx, tag, seen, cta, at, _ in sorted(records, key=lambda r: r[6])
+    ]

+    ``WAIT_BUDGET`` word, the peer table): the scalar cache, like the vector
+    L1, is coherent only through the dispatch's acquire, as the kernel
+    arguments are. LLVM sinks it to its first use (``pin_s`` keeps it put)."""
+    return fx.Int32(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, is_scalar=True))
+
+
+def pin_s(vs):
+    """``vs`` (SGPR Int32s, e.g. ``ld_s32`` words) through one opaque asm that
+    emits nothing (each output tied to its input): their loads are issued
+    before it and waited for at it, together, and what is computed from them
+    is computed after (``fresh``'s scalar twin, for a batch)."""
+    n = len(vs)
+    ty = T.i32 if n == 1 else llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32] * n)
+    r = llvm.inline_asm(
+        ty, [fx.Int32(v).ir_value() for v in vs], "",
+        ",".join(["=s"] * n + [str(j) for j in range(n)]),
+        has_side_effects=True,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    if n == 1:
+        return [fx.Int32(r)]
+    return [fx.Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, r, [j])) for j in range(n)]
+
+
+def ptr64(lo, hi):
+    """The i64 of two i32 words (low, high)."""
+    return (fx.Int64(hi) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(lo))
+
+
+def bf16_round(a):
+    return fx.Float32(fx.Float32(a).to(fx.BFloat16))
+
+
+def bf16_pair(a, b):
+    """Two f32 -> one f32-typed word holding (bf16(a), bf16(b))."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([a, b], fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Float32)[0]
+    )
+
+
+def lds_bytes(struct) -> int:
+    """The LDS an ``fx.struct`` class takes, alignment included."""
+    return struct.__dsl_size_of__()
+
+
+def bf_lo(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's low half."""
+    return (w << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf_hi(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's high half."""
+    return (w & fx.Int32(-65536)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf2_f32(w):
+    """Packed bf16 pair word -> (f32 low, f32 high)."""
+    return bf_lo(w), bf_hi(w)

+"""A kernel build's parameters, all of them in FlyDSL's JIT cache key.
+
+FlyDSL keys a compiled kernel by the scalar values (int, float, bool, str, enum,
+tuple) its launcher's closures capture; an object in a closure is not keyed, and
+a parameter used only by build-time Python (a placement table, a layout) is in no
+closure at all. Two builds differing only there would share one binary -- every
+TP rank ran rank 3's kernel once that way. So a build's parameters are one frozen
+dataclass of scalars, ``key_tuple`` turns it into one (name, value) tuple, and the
+launcher references that tuple: every field is keyed, whatever the body uses.
+
+The tuple also carries the model's kernel sources (``source_digest``): FlyDSL
+keys a helper's source only when its walk reaches it, and it does not reach a
+helper called inside a traced function's dynamic loop or branch (the rewriter
+moves those bodies into nested functions it does not scan) nor one outside the
+kernel's directory -- an edit there kept the old binary.
+"""
+
+import enum
+import functools
+import hashlib
+import inspect
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields, is_dataclass
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import health_words
+
+_SCALARS = (int, float, bool, str, enum.Enum)
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def source_digest(*paths: str) -> str:
+    """sha256 of every ``.py`` file under ``paths`` (files or directories,
+    relative to the ``mono`` package), each file's path and contents: one model's
+    kernel sources, so an edit to another model's rebuilds none of these."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    for rel in paths:
+        root = _ROOT / rel
+        files = [root] if root.is_file() else sorted(root.rglob("*.py"))
+        if not files:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no kernel sources at {root}")
+        for f in files:
+            h.update(str(f.relative_to(_ROOT)).encode())
+            h.update(f.read_bytes())
+    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def _key_items(key, prefix: str = "") -> list:
+    out = []
+    for f in fields(key):
+        value = getattr(key, f.name)
+        if is_dataclass(value):
+            out += _key_items(value, f"{prefix}{f.name}.")
+            continue
+        if not isinstance(value, _SCALARS):
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"{type(key).__name__}.{f.name} = {value!r}: a build parameter must be"
+                " a scalar (or a dataclass of them) to reach the JIT cache key"
+            )
+        out.append((prefix + f.name, value))
+    return out
+
+
+def key_tuple(key, sources: str) -> tuple:
+    """``key``'s (field name, value) pairs, every value a scalar (a nested
+    dataclass flattened, its fields named ``outer.inner``), then ("sources",
+    ``sources``): the model's ``source_digest``."""
+    return tuple(_key_items(key) + [("sources", sources)])
+
+
+# The execution model every mono kernel is written for.
+#
+# One CTA per CU of an MI355X, all of them co-resident -- a spin wait on another
+# CTA can only make progress if that CTA is running, so the runner refuses a GPU
+# with another CU count -- and THREADS threads each.
+#
+
+BLOCKS = 256
+THREADS = 512
+WAVES = THREADS // 64
+LDS_BYTES = 160 * 1024  # a CU's LDS: one CTA's whole
+
+
+# Arithmetic that runs on Python ints and traced values alike.
+
+
+def sel(pred, a, b):
+    """A if pred else b: a conditional on Python values, ``select`` on traced
+    ones (rewrapped in the traced operand's type)."""
+    if isinstance(pred, bool):
+        return a if pred else b
+    out = pred.select(a, b)
+    traced = [x for x in (a, b) if not isinstance(x, int)]
+    return type(traced[0])(out) if traced else out
+
+
+def i32(x):
+    """``x``, asserted inside the device's Int32 range when it is a Python int."""
+    if isinstance(x, int):
+        assert -(2**31) <= x < 2**31, x
+    return x
+
+
+def cdiv(a, b):
+    """ceil(a / b) for a >= 0, b > 0."""
+    return i32((a + b - 1) // b)
+
+
+def padded(n: int, align: int) -> int:
+    return cdiv(n, align) * align
+
+
+# A kernel's mailbox regions laid out in its scratch or peer buffer.
+
+PAIR_BYTES = 8  # a (value, tag) pair
+# A rank's health words (``mono.abi``), for this grid.
+HEALTH_WORDS = health_words(BLOCKS)
+
+
+def pair_layout(items, align: int = PAIR_BYTES, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """``items`` (name, pairs) laid out in order: name -> (byte offset, bytes),
+    each region from an ``align``-byte boundary at or past ``start``."""
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = (off + align - 1) // align * align
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR_BYTES)
+        off += pairs * PAIR_BYTES
+    return out
+
+
+# A kernel's argument list, named once.
+#
+# A FlyDSL kernel and its launcher each spell out their positional parameters, and
+# the host passes them by position: an argument out of order is a pointer read as
+# another, silently. ``KernelAbi`` is the one list of names; the build checks the
+# kernel's and the launcher's parameters against it, and the host packs by name.
+#
+
+
+def _python_params(fn) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Parameter names of a ``@flyc.kernel`` / ``@flyc.jit`` object's Python
+    function (FlyDSL keeps it as ``_func`` / ``func``)."""
+    py = getattr(fn, "func", None) or getattr(fn, "_func", None)
+    if py is None:
+        raise TypeError(f"no Python function behind {fn!r}")
+    return tuple(inspect.signature(py).parameters)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class KernelAbi:
+    names: tuple[str, ...]
+
+    def check(self, kernel, launcher) -> None:
+        """The kernel takes exactly ``names``; the launcher too, then ``stream``."""
+        got = _python_params(kernel)
+        if got != self.names:
+            raise TypeError(f"kernel parameters {got} != ABI {self.names}")
+        got = _python_params(launcher)
+        if got != (*self.names, "stream"):
+            raise TypeError(f"launcher parameters {got} != ABI {self.names} + stream")
+
+    def pack(self, values: dict) -> list:
+        """``values`` (every name, nothing else) in ABI order."""
+        try:
+            if len(values) == len(self.names):
+                return [values[n] for n in self.names]
+        except KeyError:
+            pass
+        extra = sorted(set(values) - set(self.names))
+        missing = sorted(set(self.names) - set(values))
+        raise TypeError(f"ABI mismatch: missing {missing}, unexpected {extra}")
+
+    def zeros(self) -> list:
+        """Every argument 0: what a compile-only call passes."""
+        return [0] * len(self.names)
+
+
+# The two spaces a mailbox region lives in (``sync.Addr``).
+
+
+class Space(Enum):
+    SCRATCH = "scratch"  # this GPU's memory: device-scope hand-off between CTAs
+    PEER = "peer"  # a peer-symmetric region: system-scope hand-off between GPUs

+"""A TP group seen from inside a kernel: every rank's peer buffer, a traced
+rank's address (``peer_at``), and an all-reduce's sum of the ranks' partials.
+``tp`` is a build-time constant."""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf2_f32,
+    ld_s32,
+    ptr64,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import Addr
+
+
+def peer_words(peers, tp):
+    """The ``peers`` table's words (an i64 a rank: low, high), scalar loads
+    (``ld_s32``) issued at once."""
+    return [ld_s32(peers, j) for j in range(2 * tp)]
+
+
+def peer_bases(words):
+    """Every rank's peer buffer base from the ``peers`` table's words
+    (``peer_words``), loaded once: a put's address must not wait on a load of
+    its own."""
+    return [ptr64(words[2 * p], words[2 * p + 1]) for p in range(len(words) // 2)]
+
+
+def peer_at(addrs, p):
+    """``addrs[p]`` (an ``Addr`` a rank, e.g. a region's ``peer`` list) for a
+    traced rank ``p``: a select chain over the ranks' addresses, the region and
+    space of rank 0's (they are all the same region)."""
+    if isinstance(p, int):
+        return addrs[p]
+    v = addrs[0].value
+    for q in range(1, len(addrs)):
+        v = fx.Int64((p == q).select(addrs[q].value, v))
+    return Addr(addrs[0].region, addrs[0].space, v)
+
+
+def sum_partials(poll, own, pair_of, tp):
+    """The ``tp`` ranks' bf16 pair partials at ``pair_of(src)`` of the mailbox
+    region ``own``, summed in fp32 in rank order 0 .. tp - 1: one poll batch ->
+    (lo sum, hi sum). Every rank sums in the same order, so they agree."""
+    ws = poll([(own, pair_of(src), 1) for src in range(tp)])
+    acc0, acc1 = bf2_f32(ws[0][0])
+    for src in range_constexpr(1, tp):
+        lo, hi = bf2_f32(ws[src][0])
+        acc0 = acc0 + lo
+        acc1 = acc1 + hi
+    return acc0, acc1

+"""The K2 route table in LDS (``RouteLds``): a step's top-8 picks and the union
+of their experts, every CTA's own copy, live from ``load_route`` to the owner
+reduce.
+
+    route   i32[MT 16]    t 16 + k: expert id (-1: dead pick); t 16 + 8 + k: the
+                          fp32 bits of its route weight (0 on a pad row)
+    flag    i32[256]      expert -> 0 / 1, then its union slot
+    expert  i32[MAX_U]    union slot -> expert id (zeroed every launch)
+    kof     i32[MAX_U 8]  slot 8 + t -> row t's top-k index k of the slot's
+                          expert, -1 when row t did not pick it
+    scan    i32[WAVES]    ``block_excl_scan``'s wave partials
+    tot     f32[MT]       sum of squares of pooled row t (``load_xq``)
+
+A pick is live iff ``0 <= id < EXPERTS``: pad rows carry -1, and a garbage id
+(a poll that timed out returns whatever the pair held) is dead too, so no table
+store runs out of bounds. Expert ids are clamped (``clamp_expert``) at every
+address use.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    EXPERTS,
+    ROUTE_LDS,
+    TOPK,
+)
+
+FIELDS = ("route", "flag", "expert", "kof", "scan", "tot")
+assert set(FIELDS) == set(ROUTE_LDS), ROUTE_LDS
+# words a field, by name (names, not subscripts, in the annotations below)
+ROUTE_W, FLAG_W, EXPERT_W, KOF_W, SCAN_W, TOT_W = (ROUTE_LDS[f] for f in FIELDS)
+
+
+@fx.struct
+class RouteLds:
+    route: fx.Array[fx.Int32, ROUTE_W, 16]
+    flag: fx.Array[fx.Int32, FLAG_W, 16]
+    expert: fx.Array[fx.Int32, EXPERT_W, 16]
+    kof: fx.Array[fx.Int32, KOF_W, 16]
+    scan: fx.Array[fx.Int32, SCAN_W, 16]
+    tot: fx.Array[fx.Float32, TOT_W, 16]
+
+
+def route_ptrs(rl) -> dict:
+    """Field -> LDS pointer of a peeked ``RouteLds`` (the context's ``rt``)."""
+    return {name: getattr(rl, name).ptr for name in FIELDS}
+
+
+def id_index(t, k):
+    """``route`` word of row t's pick k's expert id (``spec.route_id_pair``)."""
+    return t * 16 + k
+
+
+def weight_index(t, k):
+    """``route`` word of row t's pick k's weight bits (``spec.route_weight_pair``)."""
+    return t * 16 + TOPK + k
+
+
+def load_weight(rt, t, k):
+    """Row t's pick k's route weight, an fp32 (stored as its bits)."""
+    return fx.ptr_load(rt["route"] + weight_index(t, k)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def live(e):
+    """Whether expert id ``e`` names a pick (pads: -1; garbage: out of range)."""
+    return (e >= 0) & (e < EXPERTS)
+
+
+def clamp_expert(e):
+    """``e`` clamped into [0, EXPERTS): an in-bounds address for any id."""
+    return fx.max(fx.min(e, fx.Int32(EXPERTS - 1)), fx.Int32(0))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at a526f0d, MIT License,
+# Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.:
+# atom/mono/device/sync.py
+"""The tagged mailbox: hand-offs between the CTAs of one GPU (device scope) and
+between GPUs (system scope), every address a named region (``Addr``).
+
+Muse Spark: a launch's tag is ``step_tag(e, slot)`` of the 22-bit step epoch,
+and every wait's budget is the ``WAIT_BUDGET`` health word (seconds), read once
+a launch (``load_budget``), instead of the constant ``WAIT_TICKS``."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import (
+    FAILED,
+    RECORD_WORDS,
+    WAIT_BUDGET,
+    WAIT_SECONDS,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_SYS,
+    bf16_pair,
+    ld_i32,
+    ld_s32,
+    memrealtime,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import Space
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    EPOCH_MASK,
+    TAG_SLOTS,
+)
+
+POLL_MAX = 12  # mailbox specs polled per batch (bounds live registers)
+
+TICKS_PER_SECOND = 100_000_000  # s_memrealtime runs at 100 MHz
+WAIT_TICKS = WAIT_SECONDS * TICKS_PER_SECOND
+
+
+def step_tag(e, slot):
+    """A launch's mailbox tag: the step epoch ``e`` (the runner's device
+    counter, bumped once a step in the graph) masked to 22 bits, and the
+    launch's ``slot``, so no step's or other launch's pair ever passes for this
+    one's -- nothing is zeroed. ``&``, not a signed ``%``: a wrapped (negative)
+    int32 epoch still gives a valid positive tag. Never 0."""
+    return (e & EPOCH_MASK) * TAG_SLOTS + slot + 1
+
+
+def load_epoch(epoch):
+    """The step epoch word at ``epoch``, a scalar load (``ld_s32``): the runner
+    bumps it before the launch. ``step_epoch`` masks it."""
+    return ld_s32(epoch, 0)
+
+
+def step_epoch(w):
+    """The step epoch of its word ``w`` (``load_epoch``), masked to 22 bits
+    (its parity ``e & 1`` alternates across the mask's wrap: 2^22 is even)."""
+    return w & EPOCH_MASK
+
+
+def load_budget(health):
+    """This rank's ``WAIT_BUDGET`` health word, read once a launch, a scalar
+    load (``ld_s32``): the runner sets it between launches, no MonoKernel
+    writes it. ``wait_budget`` reads it."""
+    return ld_s32(health, WAIT_BUDGET)
+
+
+def wait_budget(w):
+    """An in-kernel wait's budget in seconds from its word ``w``
+    (``load_budget``). A zeroed header (health words reset without a budget)
+    falls back to ``WAIT_SECONDS`` instead of failing every wait that is not
+    satisfied at its first load."""
+    return fx.Int32((w > 0).select(w, fx.Int32(WAIT_SECONDS)))
+
+
+@traced
+def _spin(load_all, pending, health, alarm, region_id, index, tag, ticks):
+    """Re-issue ``load_all`` until ``pending`` clears, for at most ``ticks``
+    ``s_memrealtime`` ticks (the launch's ``WAIT_BUDGET``), and not at all once
+    this rank has failed (``health`` word FAILED), so a failed step runs to its
+    end instead of hanging. A side-effecting op in the loop keeps the loads from
+    being hoisted.
+
+    A CTA's first give-up is recorded in its ``health`` record; it then raises the
+    output rank's flag for this rank (``alarm``) and drains that store before it
+    sets FAILED, so no later store of this rank's can overtake the flag."""
+    t0 = memrealtime()
+    v = load_all()
+    why = fx.Int32(0)  # 1: timed out, 2: the rank had failed
+    while pending(v) & (why == 0):
+        rocdl.s_sleep(1)
+        v = load_all()
+        failed = ld_health(health, FAILED) != 0
+        late = memrealtime() - t0 > ticks
+        why = failed.select(fx.Int32(2), late.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)))
+    if why == 1:
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        rec = (bid + 1) * RECORD_WORDS
+        if ld_health(health, rec) == 0:
+            at = fx.Int32(memrealtime() & 0x7FFFFFFF)
+            record = [1, region_id, index, tag, v[1], bid, at, 0]
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):  # 16 B a store
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                        [fx.Int32(w) for w in record[4 * h : 4 * h + 4]], fx.Int32
+                    ),
+                    rsrc(health),
+                    rec + 4 * h,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        bo.buffer_store(fx.Int32(1), rsrc(alarm), 0, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+        bo.buffer_store(fx.Int32(1), rsrc(health), FAILED, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+    return v
+
+
+@traced
+def stall(fault_rank, fault_epoch, fault_slot, ticks, rank, epoch, slot):
+    """The fault hook (tests only): CTA 0 of rank ``fault_rank`` stalls ``ticks``
+    once, in the launch for slot ``fault_slot`` of the step at epoch
+    ``fault_epoch`` (the raw epoch word)."""
+    if (
+        (rank == fault_rank)
+        & (uniform(ld_i32(epoch, 0)) == fault_epoch)
+        & (slot == fault_slot)
+        & (fx.block_idx.x == 0)
+    ):
+        t0 = memrealtime()
+        now = memrealtime()
+        while now - t0 < ticks:
+            rocdl.s_sleep(127)
+            now = memrealtime()
+
+
+def ld_health(health, i):
+    return fx.Int32(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(health), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Addr:
+    """A mailbox region's address: the region's name and space, and the traced
+    address. The space sets the hand-off's scope: device for SCRATCH, system
+    for PEER."""
+
+    region: str
+    space: Space
+    value: object
+
+
+def sreg(base, offset, region):
+    """Scratch region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.SCRATCH, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def preg(base, offset, region):
+    """Peer-symmetric region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of a rank's buffer
+    ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.PEER, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def shift(a, delta):
+    """``a`` moved by ``delta`` bytes (a traced or Python integer), same region."""
+    return Addr(a.region, a.space, a.value + delta)
+
+
+def uniform_addr(a):
+    """``a`` with its address re-read from the first lane (``v_readfirstlane``):
+    a wave-uniform base that is a NEW value. Poll a region through it right
+    after a lane-predicated put to the same region (``if lane == 0: put``):
+    otherwise LLVM merges the put's buffer resource with the poll's (GVN-PRE),
+    phis it at the divergent join into VGPRs, and every poll load becomes a
+    readfirstlane waterfall loop. Only for a base that is already wave-uniform
+    (a scratch region, this rank's own peer region): lane 0's value is kept."""
+    v = fx.Int64(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i64, fx.Int64(a.value).ir_value()))
+    return Addr(a.region, a.space, v)
+
+
+# the store / load cache policy of a hand-off in each space
+_SCOPE_CM = {Space.SCRATCH: CM_DEV, Space.PEER: CM_SYS}
+
+
+class Mailbox:
+    """Tagged-pair hand-off between CTAs (device scope) and GPUs (system scope).
+
+    Every 32-bit value is stored next to this launch's tag; a consumer
+    polls the payload until all tags match, so a hand-off costs one round trip
+    (no store drain, no separate flag). The tag is ``tag + 1``, the launch's
+    ``step_tag(e, slot)`` (``Mailbox(step_tag(e, slot) - 1, ...)``): it carries
+    the step epoch the runner bumps once a step and the launch's slot, so a pair
+    from an earlier step or another launch never carries a live tag, and no
+    mailbox is ever zeroed. Every address is an ``Addr``: its space picks the
+    scope.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, tag, health, alarm, region_ids, budget):
+        """``tag``: this launch's tag - 1; ``health``: this rank's health words
+        (FAILED, then a wait record a CTA); ``alarm``: this rank's flag word on
+        the output rank; ``region_ids``: region name -> the id a record names it
+        by; ``budget``: a wait's budget in seconds (``wait_budget``)."""
+        self.tag = tag + 1
+        self.health = health
+        self.alarm = alarm
+        self.region_ids = region_ids
+        self.ticks = fx.Int64(budget) * TICKS_PER_SECOND
+
+    def put(self, a, i, v):
+        bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([bits, self.tag], fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_bf(self, a, i, vs):
+        """Elements i .. i+len(vs) (2 or 4, i aligned) as packed bf16 pairs, one
+        store."""
+        words = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(len(vs) // 2):
+            words += [bf16_pair(vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_words(self, a, i, words):
+        """Raw 32-bit words (1 or 2) at pairs i.. as (word, tag). Integer payloads
+        (fp8 words) must come this way: through an f32 value a NaN bit pattern is
+        not kept."""
+        vals = []
+        for w in words:
+            vals += [fx.Int32(w), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def poll(self, specs, batch=POLL_MAX):
+        """Batched poll of pairs ``specs`` = [(Addr, pair index, npairs in {1, 2})],
+        all of one space.
+
+        All pairs are re-loaded together while any tag is stale, so a batch costs
+        one round trip after its last producer lands. Returns the value words."""
+        if const_expr(len(specs) == 0):
+            return []
+        if const_expr(len(specs) > batch):
+            return self.poll(specs[:batch], batch) + self.poll(specs[batch:], batch)
+        spaces = {a.space for a, _, _ in specs}
+        assert len(spaces) == 1, f"one poll batch spans {spaces}"
+        cm = _SCOPE_CM[spaces.pop()]
+        bases = [a.value for a, _, _ in specs]
+        tag = self.tag
+
+        def load_all():
+            words = []
+            for b, (_, i, n) in zip(bases, specs):
+                w = fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(b),
+                        fx.Int32(i) * 2,
+                        vec_width=2 * n,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=cm,
+                    )
+                )
+                words += [w[e] for e in range(2 * n)]
+            return fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+
+        nw = sum(2 * n for _, _, n in specs)
+
+        def pending(v):
+            bad = v[1] != tag
+            for e in range_constexpr(3, nw, 2):
+                bad = bad | (v[e] != tag)
+            return bad
+
+        rid = self.region_ids.get(specs[0][0].region, -1)
+        v = _spin(
+            load_all,
+            pending,
+            self.health,
+            self.alarm,
+            rid,
+            specs[0][1],
+            tag,
+            self.ticks,
+        )
+        outs, e = [], 0
+        for _, _, n in specs:
+            outs.append([v[e + 2 * q] for q in range(n)])
+            e += 2 * n
+        return outs
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(put, a, i, v, who):
+    """This CTA's plain stores made readable by every CTA, then (thread ``who``)
+    the mailbox pair (``a``, i) := v. The stores are drained first: a flag may
+    not overtake the data it announces, and a workgroup-scope release fence does
+    not wait for them (LLVM's AMDGPU memory model omits vmcnt outside tgsplit
+    mode: the workgroup's waves share one CU, the readers here do not)."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if who:
+        put(a, i, v)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""K1's residual boundary (DESIGN_BC 5.4, Phase B1) on the weight-free CTAs
+j in [0, NA): columns 128 j .. of the 8192; and the epilogue CTAs' step
+inputs (5.6), loaded at CTA entry with the boundary's.
+
+Stock reference: ``_norm_residual_norm_fwd_kernel``
+(``common/ops/fused_rmsnorm.py``) with the previous layer's ``post_ffn_norm``
+(weight before the norm, gain center 1.0, eps 1e-8), the per-channel gated
+blend ``alpha stream + beta y`` (``add_ffn``) and this layer's
+``pre_qkv_proj_norm`` (weight after the norm, gain center 1.0, eps 1e-5), bf16
+out::
+
+    x        = f32(branch) (w_post + 1)                     (one fp32 product)
+    y        = x rsq(sum(x^2) / 8192 + 1e-8)
+    stream'  = alpha stream + beta y                         (fp32)
+    attn_in  = bf16((stream' rsq(sum(stream'^2) / 8192 + 1e-5)) (w_pre + 1))
+
+This is K2's seam (``stages/seam.py``) with the deferred branch (plain loads:
+the previous launch wrote it) in place of the all-reduce, and the post weight
+applied first; past ``x`` both run ``seam.blend_norm``. Wave w is token t = w
+(t < S live; waves past S only take the barriers); lane l owns columns
+c = 128 j + 2 l, + 1. A row's sums of squares are the 64 slices' partials
+(``fss`` / ``nss``), one fixed butterfly each, so every boundary CTA derives
+the same totals. Pad rows are zeros everywhere (``select``: NaN in a pad row's
+branch or stream never leaks); their partials are still published.
+
+Outputs: ``stream_out`` (fp32, plain stores; K2's ``stream``), ``arow`` (bf16
+attn_in rows, device scope, scratch) and slice j's ``ardy`` flag (``publish``:
+the arow stores drained, then the flag) for the GEMV CTAs whose K parts read
+slice j (``front/qkv.py``).
+
+Rule 8 (DESIGN_BC 10.4): the boundary issues no weight load. At its polls a
+wave has in flight only ``boundary_loads``' operands and ``epilogue_inputs``'
+three loads (pad, position, slot), and every boundary CTA puts before it
+polls, so the boundary CTAs depend only on each other (5.3). The stage keeps
+everything in registers: no LDS member, no hand-over barrier owed.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf2_f32,
+    ld_i32,
+    ld_pad,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    WAVES,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import publish
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    AROW,
+    COLS,
+    E_UNITS,
+    GAIN,
+    HIDDEN,
+    MAX_ROWS,
+    NA,
+    POST_FFN_EPS,
+    RMS_EPS,
+    ardy_pair,
+    arow_elem,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages.seam import (
+    blend_norm,
+)
+
+assert COLS == 2 * 64 and NA == HIDDEN // COLS  # a lane 2 columns of a slice
+assert NA == 64  # a lane reads one slice's partial of each sum of squares
+assert MAX_ROWS <= WAVES  # a wave a row
+assert E_UNITS * MAX_ROWS <= NA  # the epilogue CTAs are boundary CTAs
+
+
+def _ld_f32x2(ptr, i):
+    """fp32 elements i, i + 1 (i even)."""
+    v = fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=2, dtype=T.f32))
+    return v[0], v[1]
+
+
+def _ld_i64(ptr, i):
+    """int64 element i (two words: the high one sign-extends)."""
+    w = fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32))
+    return (fx.Int64(w[1]) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(w[0]))
+
+
+def _gained(ptr, col):
+    """A bf16 norm weight's two columns ``col``, ``col + 1`` + the gain
+    center, one f32 add (``fused_rmsnorm.py``'s ``_effective_weight``)."""
+    w0, w1 = bf2_f32(ld_i32(ptr, col // 2))
+    return w0 + fx.Float32(GAIN), w1 + fx.Float32(GAIN)
+
+
+def boundary_loads(c, j):
+    """Slice j's inputs, all issued before the stage's polls (none needs a
+    wait): this wave's rows of the stream and the branch, the blend
+    coefficients and both norm weights at the lane's two columns, and the
+    row's pad flag. Waves past S load row S - 1 (in bounds; never used). The
+    keys ``seam.blend_norm`` reads are ``seam.seam_loads``'."""
+    s, lane, wave = c["S"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    t = fx.min(wave, s - 1)
+    col = j * COLS + 2 * lane
+    s0, s1 = _ld_f32x2(a["stream"], t * HIDDEN + col)
+    a0, a1 = _ld_f32x2(a["ffn_alpha"], col)
+    b0, b1 = _ld_f32x2(a["ffn_beta"], col)
+    p0, p1 = _gained(a["w_postffn"], col)
+    w0, w1 = _gained(a["w_preqkv"], col)
+    x0, x1 = bf2_f32(ld_i32(a["branch"], (t * HIDDEN + col) // 2))
+    return {
+        "t": t,
+        "col": col,
+        "s": (s0, s1),
+        "alpha": (a0, a1),
+        "beta": (b0, b1),
+        "wpost": (p0, p1),
+        "w": (w0, w1),
+        "branch": (x0, x1),
+        "pad": ld_pad(a["pad"], t),
+    }
+
+
+def epilogue_inputs(c, u):
+    """Epilogue unit u's step inputs (DESIGN_BC 5.6), issued at CTA entry with
+    ``boundary_loads`` (before any poll): token t = u // E_UNITS, its pad
+    flag, position and slot (int64, ``positions[t]`` / ``slots[t]``; a slot
+    < 0 inserts nothing). Every lane holds the same values (VGPRs: ``uniform``
+    them where an address must be wave-uniform). A CTA past E_UNITS S (no
+    epilogue unit) loads row S - 1: in bounds, never used. ``g5`` = u %
+    E_UNITS is the unit's row group (``epilogue.unit_row``)."""
+    s = c["S"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    t = fx.min(u // E_UNITS, s - 1)
+    return {
+        "t": t,
+        "g5": u % E_UNITS,
+        "pad": ld_pad(a["pad"], t),
+        "pos": _ld_i64(a["positions"], t),
+        "slot": _ld_i64(a["slots"], t),
+    }
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_boundary(c, j, pre):
+    """Slice j: the deferred branch -> the post-FFN norm (weight first) and
+    the gated blend -> ``stream_out``; the pre-qkv norm -> ``arow``; then the
+    slice's ``ardy`` flag."""
+    s, tid, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["wave"]
+    a, scr = c["args"], c["scr"]
+    dead = pre["pad"]
+    zero = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    if wave < s:
+        x0, x1 = pre["branch"]
+        p0, p1 = pre["wpost"]
+        # fused_rmsnorm.py's POST_INPUT_SCALE: the weight before the norm
+        x0 = dead.select(zero, x0 * p0)
+        x1 = dead.select(zero, x1 * p1)
+        blend_norm(
+            c,
+            j,
+            pre,
+            x0,
+            x1,
+            (scr["fss"], scr["nss"]),
+            POST_FFN_EPS,
+            RMS_EPS,
+            (a["stream_out"], scr[AROW], arow_elem),
+        )
+    publish(c["put"], scr["ardy"], ardy_pair(j), fx.Int32(1), tid == 0)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""K1's epilogue (DESIGN_BC 5.6, Phase B1) on the epilogue CTAs u in [0,
+E_UNITS S): the qkv rows out of the GEMV partials, the weightless QK-norm,
+GPT-J RoPE on sliding layers, and this step's K / V into the layer's cache.
+
+Stock reference: ``fusedMuseSparkQKNormRopeKVInsertKernel``
+(``csrc/fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert_kernel.cu``), the instance
+decode runs (HEADS_PER_GROUP 1, bf16 KV, fp32 table; its gfx950 ISA,
+DESIGN_BC 1.3), bit for bit on the same bf16 GEMV rows. A head is 8 lanes
+there, lane li dims 8 li .. 8 li + 7; here a head is a wave, lane d dim d::
+
+    x    = f32(bf16(p_0 + p_1))           the two contributors' partials
+    tot  = ((s0+s4)+(s2+s6)) + ((s1+s5)+(s3+s7)),  s_li the serial sum
+           RN(x_8li^2) + ... + RN(x_8li+7^2)        (``ops.seq8_sum``)
+    x    = RN(x rsq(fma(tot, 2^-6, eps)))           q and k heads only
+    rope (sliding layers; pair i of chunk li: dims 2i, 2i + 1, c = cos[pos,
+          4 li + i], s = sin[pos, 4 li + i]):
+           dim 0      RN(RN(x0 c) - RN(x1 s))       two rounded products
+           1, 3, 5    fma(x_odd, c, RN(x_even s))
+           2, 4, 6    fma(x_even, c, -RN(x_odd s))
+           7          fma(x6, s, RN(x7 c))          the fused product is x6 s
+    out  = bf16(x)                        one rounding; v and og verbatim
+
+Full layers are NoPE (``K1Build.rope`` False: no table read). The squares
+and the products are separate multiplies (FlyDSL emits no ``contract``
+flag, so LLVM fuses nothing it is not given as ``fmath.fma``).
+
+Unit u = token t = u // 5, group g5 = u % 5; wave w is a head slot, lane d a
+dim (DESIGN_BC 5.6's table, ``unit_row``): g5 0, 1 q heads 8 g5 + w; g5 2
+waves 0, 1 the k heads, 2, 3 the v heads (4-7 idle); g5 3, 4 og heads 8
+(g5 - 3) + w. Every live wave polls its row's two ``qpart`` pairs (one
+batch), then stores ``qkvo`` (a pad row as zeros) and, on the k / v waves,
+the cache: slot >= 0 only (the stock rule: MRV2 pad rows are -1), never a
+block at or past ``kv_blocks`` (a garbage slot stays in bounds), never once
+this rank has FAILED (a rank that gave up must not write stale K / V for the
+steps until the engine stops). A pad row's position is 0 (its K, if its slot
+were live, is roped there).
+
+Every scalar of the step (pad, position, slot) is loaded at the CTA's entry
+(``boundary.epilogue_inputs``, with the boundary's loads; made wave-uniform
+here) and the cos / sin row before the poll: the poll holds only this task's
+operands (rule 8). The cache page is a 64-bit address (a block stride times
+a block id passes 4 GiB; LHBNC's head stride is ~5.5 GB) built from
+wave-uniform values, so its buffer resource stays scalar.
+
+The stage uses no LDS (registers and DPP only) and no barrier.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import FAILED
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf16_round,
+    hw_rsq,
+    rsrc,
+    seq8_sum,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    xshfl,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    sel,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (
+    ld_health,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    E_UNITS,
+    HEAD_DIM,
+    KV_BLOCK,
+    KV_HEADS,
+    QKV_ROWS,
+    RMS_EPS,
+    ROW_G,
+    ROW_K,
+    ROW_Q,
+    ROW_V,
+    ROWS,
+    V_OFF,
+    WAVES,
+    qpart_pair,
+)
+
+INV_D = 2.0**-6  # 1 / HEAD_DIM: the .cu's ``sumsq / 64`` is fma(tot, 2^-6, eps)
+ROPE_COLS = HEAD_DIM  # a cos_sin_cache row: cos in 0 .. 31, sin in 32 .. 63
+KV_WAVES = 2 * KV_HEADS  # g5 2: the k heads, then the v heads
+assert HEAD_DIM == 64 and ROW_K + KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM == ROW_V and V_OFF == HEAD_DIM
+assert 2 * WAVES * HEAD_DIM == ROW_K and 2 * WAVES * HEAD_DIM == QKV_ROWS - ROW_G
+
+
+def unit_row(g5, w):
+    """Unit group ``g5``'s first row of wave ``w`` (the head's dim 0) and
+    whether the wave is live, a q / k head (normalized) and a k / v head
+    (inserted): (row0, live, qk, kv). Python ints or wave-uniform
+    traced Int32 alike."""
+    rq = ROW_Q + HEAD_DIM * (WAVES * g5 + w)
+    rk = ROW_K + HEAD_DIM * w  # k heads 0, 1 then v heads 0, 1: contiguous
+    rg = ROW_G + HEAD_DIM * (WAVES * (g5 - 3) + w)
+    row0 = sel(g5 < 2, rq, sel(g5 == 2, rk, rg))
+    is_kv = g5 == 2
+    kv = is_kv & (w < KV_WAVES)
+    live = (g5 != 2) | (w < KV_WAVES)
+    qk = (g5 < 2) | (is_kv & (w < KV_HEADS))
+    return row0, live, qk, kv
+
+
+def _uniform64(v):
+    """An Int64 every lane holds the same value of (a loaded position or
+    slot), wave-uniform: each half through ``uniform``."""
+    lo = uniform(fx.Int32(v))
+    hi = uniform(fx.Int32(v >> 32))
+    return (fx.Int64(hi) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(lo))
+
+
+def rope_loads(c, pos, lane):
+    """The cos / sin of dim ``lane``'s pair at row ``pos`` (Int32, clamped)
+    of the layer's fp32 ``cos_sin_cache``: cos[pos, d // 2], sin[pos, d // 2]."""
+    r = rsrc(c["args"]["cos_sin"])
+    i = pos * ROPE_COLS + lane // 2
+    cs = fx.Float32(bo.buffer_load(r, i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.f32))
+    sn = fx.Float32(bo.buffer_load(r, i + ROPE_COLS // 2, vec_width=1, dtype=T.f32))
+    return cs, sn
+
+
+def qk_norm(x, lane):
+    """A head's weightless RMS norm in the fused insert's order (1.3 steps
+    2-5): RN(x rsq(fma(tot, 2^-6, eps))), ``tot`` the 8-lane chains and tree
+    of the rounded squares. Every lane of the wave must be active."""
+    tot = seq8_sum(x * x, lane)
+    q = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(tot, fx.Float32(INV_D), fx.Float32(RMS_EPS)))
+    return x * hw_rsq(q)
+
+
+def rope(x, cs, sn, lane):
+    """GPT-J RoPE of a normalized head, the instance's per-dim arithmetic
+    (1.3 step 6, review 0 D1): the partner dim d ^ 1 by DPP; both products
+    rounded in every lane, then per d % 8 the sub of two rounded products
+    (dim 0), the fma with the fused product x6 s (dim 7), or fma(x, c, -+
+    RN(x_partner s)) (dims 1-6)."""
+    pr = xshfl(x, 1)
+    a = pr * sn
+    b = x * cs
+    k8 = lane % 8
+    even = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(x, cs, -a))
+    odd = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(x, cs, a))
+    d7 = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(pr, sn, b))
+    mid = fx.Float32(((lane % 2) == 0).select(even, odd))
+    return fx.Float32((k8 == 0).select(b - a, (k8 == 7).select(d7, mid)))
+
+
+def _partials(c, tile, t, r16):
+    """The fp32 sum of row r16 of ``tile``'s two contributors' partials for
+    token t, in contributor order."""
+    scr = c["scr"]
+    got = c["poll"](
+        [
+            (scr["qpart"], qpart_pair(tile, 0, t, r16), 1),
+            (scr["qpart"], qpart_pair(tile, 1, t, r16), 1),
+        ]
+    )
+    return got[0][0].bitcast(fx.Float32) + got[1][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def stage_epilogue(c, u, inputs) -> None:
+    """Unit u (module docstring): the partials -> ``qkvo``, the k / v heads
+    into the cache. RoPE iff the context's build key is a ``K1Build`` with
+    ``rope``."""
+    rope_on = bool(getattr(c["key"], "rope", False))
+    _stage(c, u, inputs, rope_on)
+
+
+@traced
+def _stage(c, u, inputs, rope_on):
+    lane = c["lane"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    t = u // E_UNITS
